1135 ! ----------------------------------------------------------- !
1136 ! Choice of 'CIN = cin' (.true.) or 'CIN = cinlcl' (.false.). !
1137 ! !
1138 ! Feb 2007, Bundy: Note that use_CINcin = .false. will try to !
1139 ! use a variable (del_cinlcl) that is not currently set !
1140 ! !
1141 ! Sept 2012, Santos: The fact that this is still true over 5 !
1142 ! years later suggests that this option needs to be !
1143 ! fixed or abandoned. !
1144 ! ----------------------------------------------------------- !
1145
1146 logical , parameter :: use_CINcin = .true.
1147
1148 ! --------------------------------------------------------------- !
1149 ! Choice of 'explicit' ( 1 ) or 'implicit' ( 2 ) CIN. !
1150 ! !
1151 ! When choose 'CIN = cinlcl' above, it is recommended not to use !
1152 ! implicit CIN, i.e., do 'NOT' choose simultaneously : !
1153 ! [ 'use_CINcin=.false. & 'iter_cin=2' ] !
1154 ! since 'cinlcl' will be always set to zero whenever LCL is below !
1155 ! the PBL top interface in the current code. So, averaging cinlcl !
1156 ! of two iter_cin steps is likely not so good. Except that, all !
1157 ! the other combinations of 'use_CINcin' & 'iter_cin' are OK. !
1158 ! --------------------------------------------------------------- !
1159
1160 integer , parameter :: iter_cin = 2
1161
1162 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------- !
1163 ! Choice of 'self-detrainment' by negative buoyancy in calculating !
1164 ! cumulus updraft mass flux at the top interface in each layer. !
1165 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------- !
1166
1167 logical , parameter :: use_self_detrain = .false.
1168
1169 ! --------------------------------------------------------- !
1170 ! Cumulus momentum flux : turn-on (.true.) or off (.false.) !
1171 ! --------------------------------------------------------- !
1172
1173 logical , parameter :: use_momenflx = .true.
1174
1175 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1176 ! Penetrative Entrainment : Cumulative ( .true. , original ) or Non-Cumulative ( .false. ) !
1177 ! This option ( .false. ) is designed to reduce the sensitivity to the vertical resolution. !
1178 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1179
1180 logical , parameter :: use_cumpenent = .true.
1181
1182 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1183 ! Computation of the grid-mean condensate tendency. !
1184 ! use_expconten = .true. : explcitly compute tendency by condensate detrainment and compensating subsidence !
1185 ! use_expconten = .false. : use the original proportional condensate tendency equation. ( original ) !
1186 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1187
1188 logical , parameter :: use_expconten = .true.
1189
1190 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1191 ! Treatment of reserved condensate !
1192 ! use_unicondet = .true. : detrain condensate uniformly over the environment ( original ) !
1193 ! use_unicondet = .false. : detrain condensate into the pre-existing stratus !
1194 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1195
1196 logical , parameter :: use_unicondet = .false.

1204 parameter (rkm = 14.0_r8) ! Determine the amount of air that is involved in buoyancy-sorting [no unit]
1205
1206 parameter (rkfre = 1.0_r8) ! Vertical velocity variance as fraction of tke.
1207 parameter (rmaxfrac = 0.10_r8) ! Maximum allowable 'core' updraft fraction
1208 parameter (mumin1 = 0.906_r8) ! Normalized CIN ('mu') corresponding to 'rmaxfrac' at the PBL top
1209 ! obtaind by inverting 'rmaxfrac = 0.5*erfc(mumin1)'.
1210 ! [rmaxfrac:mumin1]=[ 0.05:1.163, 0.075:1.018, 0.1:0.906, 0.15:0.733, 0.2:0.595, 0.25:0.477]
1211 parameter (rbuoy = 1.0_r8) ! For nonhydrostatic pressure effects on updraft [no unit]

1213
1214 parameter (epsvarw = 5.e-4_r8) ! Variance of w at PBL top by meso-scale component [m2/s2]
1215 parameter (PGFc = 0.7_r8) ! This is used for calculating vertical variations cumulus
1216 ! 'u' & 'v' by horizontal PGF during upward motion [no unit]

1221 ! criqc : Maximum condensate that can be hold by cumulus updraft [kg/kg] !

1223 ! from cumulus updraft. The remaining fraction ('1-frc_rasn') is !
1224 ! 'suspended condensate'. !
1225 ! 0 : all expelled condensate is 'suspended condensate' !
1226 ! 1 : all expelled condensate is 'precipitable condensate' !
1227 ! kevp : Evaporative efficiency !
1228 ! noevap_krelkpen : No evaporation from 'krel' to 'kpen' layers !
1229 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------- !

1424 !----- 1. Compute internal environmental variables

14262156856044575024 exn0(:mkx) = (p0(:mkx)/p00)**rovcp
14272228751246012928 exns0(0:mkx) = (ps0(0:mkx)/p00)**rovcp
14282156856023006464 qt0(:mkx) = (qv0(:mkx) + ql0(:mkx) + qi0(:mkx))
14292156856023006464 thl0(:mkx) = (t0(:mkx) - xlv*ql0(:mkx)/cp - xls*qi0(:mkx)/cp)/exn0(:mkx)
14302156856023006464 thvl0(:mkx) = (1._r8 + zvir*qt0(:mkx))*thl0(:mkx)
1431
1432 !----- 2. Compute slopes of environmental variables in each layer
1433 ! Dimension of ssthl0(:mkx) is implicit.
1434
14357189522156856 ssthl0 = slope(mkx,thl0,p0)
14367189522156856 ssqt0 = slope(mkx,qt0 ,p0)
14377189522156856 ssu0 = slope(mkx,u0 ,p0)
14387189522156856 ssv0 = slope(mkx,v0 ,p0)
14394098026441699216 do m = 1, ncnst
144012294079201557250032 sstr0(:mkx,m) = slope(mkx,tr0(:mkx,m),p0)
1441 enddo
1442
1443 !*************
1444 !Water tracers
1445 !*************
1446 !NOTE: This variables is needed since slope(sum) /= sum(slope) - JN
1447 !NOTE: The actual slope function they use has min/max calls which don't make
1448 !any sense to me, since you should be able to calculate the slope directly
1449 !without too many problems. I should probably talk to someone about that
1450 ! - JN.
1451718952718952 if(trace_water) then
145228758083594760 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
14538627424092025856 wt0(:mkx,m) = tr0(:mkx,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) + tr0(:mkx,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) + tr0(:mkx,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice))
145486274240109280704 sswt0(:,m) = slope(mkx,wt0(:mkx,m) ,p0)
1455 end do
1456 end if
1457 !*************
1458
1459 !----- 3. Compute "thv0" and "thvl0" at the top/bottom interfaces in each layer
1460 ! There are computed from the reconstructed thl, qt at the top/bottom.
1461
1462 !NOTE: Given that this section is used purely to calculate thermodynamic variables, and not
1463 !moisture tendencies, there is not need to call water tracer subroutines here. - JN
1464
14652156856022287512 do k = 1, mkx
1466
14672156856021568560 thl0bot = thl0(k) + ssthl0(k)*(ps0(k-1) - p0(k))
1468 qt0bot = qt0(k) + ssqt0(k) *(ps0(k-1) - p0(k))
14692156856021568560 call conden(ps0(k-1),thl0bot,qt0bot,thj,qvj,qlj,qij,qse,id_check,ncnst)
14702156856021568560 if( id_check .eq. 1 ) then
147100 exit_conden(i) = 1._r8
1472 id_exit = .true.
1473 go to 333
1474 end if
14752156856021568560 thv0bot(k) = thj*(1._r8 + zvir*qvj - qlj - qij)
1476 thvl0bot(k) = thl0bot*(1._r8 + zvir*qt0bot)
1477
1478 thl0top = thl0(k) + ssthl0(k)*(ps0(k) - p0(k))
1479 qt0top = qt0(k) + ssqt0(k) *(ps0(k) - p0(k))
14802156856021568560 call conden(ps0(k),thl0top,qt0top,thj,qvj,qlj,qij,qse,id_check,ncnst)
14812156856021568560 if( id_check .eq. 1 ) then
148200 exit_conden(i) = 1._r8
1483 id_exit = .true.
1484 go to 333
1485 end if
1486 thv0top(k) = thj*(1._r8 + zvir*qvj - qlj - qij)
1487 thvl0top(k) = thl0top*(1._r8 + zvir*qt0top)
1488
1489 end do

16068627424096339568 wtdwten(:mkx,:) = 0.0_r8

1624 !-----------------------------------------------!
1625 ! Below 'iter' loop is for implicit CIN closure !
1626 !-----------------------------------------------!
1627
1628 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1629 ! It is important to note that this iterative cin loop is located at the outest !
1630 ! shell of the code. Thus, source air properties can also be changed during the !
1631 ! iterative cin calculation, because cumulus convection induces non-zero fluxes !
1632 ! even at interfaces below PBL top height through 'fluxbelowinv' subroutine. !
1633 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1634
16357189521306587 do iter = 1, iter_cin
1636
1637 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1638 ! Cumulus scale height !
1639 ! In contrast to the premitive code, cumulus scale height is iteratively !
1640 ! calculated at each time step, and at each iterative cin step. !
1641 ! It is not clear whether I should locate below two lines within or out !
1642 ! of the iterative cin loop. !
1643 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1644
164510215411021541 tscaleh = cush
1646 cush = -1._r8
1647
1648 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1649 ! Find PBL top height interface index, 'kinv-1' where 'kinv' is the layer !
1650 ! index with PBLH in it. When PBLH is exactly at interface, 'kinv' is the !
1651 ! layer index having PBLH as a lower interface. !
1652 ! In the previous code, I set the lower limit of 'kinv' by 2 in order to !
1653 ! be consistent with the other parts of the code. However in the modified !
1654 ! code, I allowed 'kinv' to be 1 & if 'kinv = 1', I just exit the program !
1655 ! without performing cumulus convection. This new approach seems to be !
1656 ! more reasonable: if PBL height is within 'kinv=1' layer, surface is STL !
1657 ! interface (bflxs <= 0) and interface just above the surface should be !
1658 ! either non-turbulent (Ri>0.19) or stably turbulent (0<=Ri<0.19 but this !
1659 ! interface is identified as a base external interface of upperlying CL. !
1660 ! Thus, when 'kinv=1', PBL scheme guarantees 'bflxs <= 0'. For this case !
1661 ! it is reasonable to assume that cumulus convection does not happen. !
1662 ! When these is SBCL, PBL height from the PBL scheme is likely to be very !
1663 ! close at 'kinv-1' interface, but not exactly, since 'zi' information is !
1664 ! changed between two model time steps. In order to ensure correct identi !
1665 ! fication of 'kinv' for general case including SBCL, I imposed an offset !
1666 ! of 5 [m] in the below 'kinv' finding block. !
1667 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1668
16692671546826715468 do k = mkx - 1, 1, -1
16702765066927650669 if( (pblh + 5._r8 - zs0(k))*(pblh + 5._r8 - zs0(k+1)) .lt. 0._r8 ) then
1671935201935201 kinv = k + 1
1672 go to 15
1673 endif
1674 end do
16758634086340 kinv = 1
167615 continue
1677
167810215411021541 if( kinv .le. 1 ) then
16798634086340 exit_kinv1(i) = 1._r8
1680 id_exit = .true.
1681 go to 333
1682 endif
1683 ! From here, it must be 'kinv >= 2'.
1684
1685 ! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1686 ! Find PBL averaged tke ('tkeavg') and minimum 'thvl' ('thvlmin') in the PBL !
1687 ! In the current code, 'tkeavg' is obtained by averaging all interfacial TKE !
1688 ! within the PBL. However, in order to be conceptually consistent with PBL !
1689 ! scheme, 'tkeavg' should be calculated by considering surface buoyancy flux.!
1690 ! If surface buoyancy flux is positive ( bflxs >0 ), surface interfacial TKE !
1691 ! should be included in calculating 'tkeavg', while if bflxs <= 0, surface !
1692 ! interfacial TKE should not be included in calculating 'tkeavg'. I should !
1693 ! modify the code when 'bflxs' is available as an input of cumulus scheme. !
1694 ! 'thvlmin' is a minimum 'thvl' within PBL obtained by comparing top & base !
1695 ! interface values of 'thvl' in each layers within the PBL. !
1696 ! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1697
1698935201935201 dpsum = 0._r8
1699 tkeavg = 0._r8
1700 thvlmin = 1000._r8
170138444223844422 do k = 0, kinv - 1 ! Here, 'k' is an interfacial layer index.
170238444223844422 if( k .eq. 0 ) then
1703935201935201 dpi = ps0(0) - p0(1)
170429092212909221 elseif( k .eq. (kinv-1) ) then
1705935201935201 dpi = p0(kinv-1) - ps0(kinv-1)
1706 else
170719740201974020 dpi = p0(k) - p0(k+1)
1708 endif
170938444223844422 dpsum = dpsum + dpi
1710 tkeavg = tkeavg + dpi*tke(k)
171129092212909221 if( k .ne. 0 ) thvlmin = min(thvlmin,min(thvl0bot(k),thvl0top(k)))
1712 end do
1713935201935201 tkeavg = tkeavg/dpsum
1714
1715 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------ !
1716 ! Find characteristics of cumulus source air: qtsrc,thlsrc,usrc,vsrc !
1717 ! Note that 'thlsrc' was con-cocked using 'thvlsrc' and 'qtsrc'. !
1718 ! 'qtsrc' is defined as the lowest layer mid-point value; 'thlsrc' !
1719 ! is from 'qtsrc' and 'thvlmin=thvlsrc'; 'usrc' & 'vsrc' are defined !
1720 ! as the values just below the PBL top interface. !
1721 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------ !
1722
1723 qtsrc = qt0(1)
1724 thvlsrc = thvlmin
1725 thlsrc = thvlsrc / ( 1._r8 + zvir * qtsrc )
1726 usrc = u0(kinv-1) + ssu0(kinv-1) * ( ps0(kinv-1) - p0(kinv-1) )
1727 vsrc = v0(kinv-1) + ssv0(kinv-1) * ( ps0(kinv-1) - p0(kinv-1) )
17285330645753306457 do m = 1, ncnst
1729 trsrc(m) = tr0(1,m)
1730 enddo
1731
1732 !*************
1733 !Water tracers
1734 !*************
1735935201935201 if(trace_water) then
173637408044676005 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
1737 wtsrc(m) = wt0(1,m)
1738 end do
1739 end if
1740 !*************
1741
1742 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------ !
1743 ! Find LCL of the source air and a layer index containing LCL (klcl) !
1744 ! When the LCL is exactly at the interface, 'klcl' is a layer index !
1745 ! having 'plcl' as the lower interface similar to the 'kinv' case. !
1746 ! In the previous code, I assumed that if LCL is located within the !
1747 ! lowest model layer ( 1 ) or the top model layer ( mkx ), then no !
1748 ! convective adjustment is performed and just exited. However, in !
1749 ! the revised code, I relaxed the first constraint and even though !
1750 ! LCL is at the lowest model layer, I allowed cumulus convection to !
1751 ! be initiated. For this case, cumulus convection should be started !
1752 ! from the PBL top height, as shown in the following code. !
1753 ! When source air is already saturated even at the surface, klcl is !
1754 ! set to 1. !
1755 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------ !
1756
17579352011870402 plcl = qsinvert(qtsrc,thlsrc,ps0(0))
175836146113614611 do k = 0, mkx
175945498124549812 if( ps0(k) .lt. plcl ) then
1760935201935201 klcl = k
1761 go to 25
1762 endif
1763 end do
176400 klcl = mkx
176525 continue
1766935201935201 klcl = max(1,klcl)
1767
1768 if( plcl .lt. 30000._r8 ) then
1769 ! if( klcl .eq. mkx ) then
177000 exit_klclmkx(i) = 1._r8
1771 id_exit = .true.
1772 go to 333
1773 endif
1774
1775 ! ------------------------------------------------------------- !
1776 ! Calculate environmental virtual potential temperature at LCL, !
1777 !'thv0lcl' which is solely used in the 'cin' calculation. Note !
1778 ! that 'thv0lcl' is calculated first by calculating 'thl0lcl' !
1779 ! and 'qt0lcl' at the LCL, and performing 'conden' afterward, !
1780 ! in fully consistent with the other parts of the code. !
1781 ! ------------------------------------------------------------- !
1782
1783 !NOTE: This section of code appears to be purely for calculating thermodynamic
1784 !variables, and thus does not need any water tracer code - JN.
1785
1786935201935201 thl0lcl = thl0(klcl) + ssthl0(klcl) * ( plcl - p0(klcl) )
1787 qt0lcl = qt0(klcl) + ssqt0(klcl) * ( plcl - p0(klcl) )
1788935201935201 call conden(plcl,thl0lcl,qt0lcl,thj,qvj,qlj,qij,qse,id_check,ncnst)
1789935201935201 if( id_check .eq. 1 ) then
179000 exit_conden(i) = 1._r8
1791 id_exit = .true.
1792 go to 333
1793 end if
1794935201935201 thv0lcl = thj * ( 1._r8 + zvir * qvj - qlj - qij )
1795
1796 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------------ !
1797 ! Compute Convective Inhibition, 'cin' & 'cinlcl' [J/kg]=[m2/s2] TKE unit. !
1798 ! !
1799 ! 'cin' (cinlcl) is computed from the PBL top interface to LFC (LCL) using !
1800 ! piecewisely reconstructed environmental profiles, assuming environmental !
1801 ! buoyancy profile within each layer ( or from LCL to upper interface in !
1802 ! each layer ) is simply a linear profile. For the purpose of cin (cinlcl) !
1803 ! calculation, we simply assume that lateral entrainment does not occur in !
1804 ! updrafting cumulus plume, i.e., cumulus source air property is conserved.!
1805 ! Below explains some rules used in the calculations of cin (cinlcl). In !
1806 ! general, both 'cin' and 'cinlcl' are calculated from a PBL top interface !
1807 ! to LCL and LFC, respectively : !
1808 ! 1. If LCL is lower than the PBL height, cinlcl = 0 and cin is calculated !
1809 ! from PBL height to LFC. !
1810 ! 2. If LCL is higher than PBL height, 'cinlcl' is calculated by summing !
1811 ! both positive and negative cloud buoyancy up to LCL using 'single_cin'!
1812 ! From the LCL to LFC, however, only negative cloud buoyancy is counted !
1813 ! to calculate final 'cin' upto LFC. !
1814 ! 3. If either 'cin' or 'cinlcl' is negative, they are set to be zero. !
1815 ! In the below code, 'klfc' is the layer index containing 'LFC' similar to !
1816 ! 'kinv' and 'klcl'. !
1817 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------------ !
1818
1819 cin = 0._r8
1820 cinlcl = 0._r8
1821 plfc = 0._r8
1822 klfc = mkx
1823
1824 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1825 ! Case 1. LCL height is higher than PBL interface ( 'pLCL <= ps0(kinv-1)' ) !
1826 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
1827
1828 if( klcl .ge. kinv ) then
1829
183023146432855417 do k = kinv, mkx - 1
183127835202783520 if( k .lt. klcl ) then
1832262405262405 thvubot = thvlsrc
1833 thvutop = thvlsrc
1834262405524810 cin = cin + single_cin(ps0(k-1),thv0bot(k),ps0(k),thv0top(k),thvubot,thvutop)
183525211152521115 elseif( k .eq. klcl ) then
1836 !----- Bottom to LCL
1837540774540774 thvubot = thvlsrc
1838 thvutop = thvlsrc
18395407741081548 cin = cin + single_cin(ps0(k-1),thv0bot(k),plcl,thv0lcl,thvubot,thvutop)
18401695016950 if( cin .lt. 0._r8 ) limit_cinlcl(i) = 1._r8
1841540774540774 cinlcl = max(cin,0._r8)
1842 cin = cinlcl
1843 !----- LCL to Top
1844 thvubot = thvlsrc
1845540774540774 call conden(ps0(k),thlsrc,qtsrc,thj,qvj,qlj,qij,qse,id_check,ncnst)
1846540774540774 if( id_check .eq. 1 ) then
184700 exit_conden(i) = 1._r8
1848 id_exit = .true.
1849 go to 333
1850 end if
1851540774540774 thvutop = thj * ( 1._r8 + zvir*qvj - qlj - qij )

1956 ! also that since 'cinlcl' is set to zero whenever LCL is below the PBL top, !
1957 ! (see above CIN calculation part), the use of 'implicit CIN=cinlcl' is not !
1958 ! good. Thus, when using implicit CIN, always try to only use 'implicit CIN= !

2264 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------ !
2265 ! Define a release level, 'prel' and release layer, 'krel'. !
2266 ! 'prel' is the lowest level from which buoyancy sorting occurs, and !
2267 ! 'krel' is the layer index containing 'prel' in it, similar to the !
2268 ! previous definitions of 'kinv', 'klcl', and 'klfc'. In order to !
2269 ! ensure that only PBL scheme works within the PBL, if LCL is below !
2270 ! PBL top height, then 'krel = kinv', while if LCL is above PBL top !
2271 ! height, then 'krel = klcl'. Note however that regardless of the !
2272 ! definition of 'krel', cumulus convection induces fluxes within PBL !
2273 ! through 'fluxbelowinv'. We can make cumulus convection start from !
2274 ! any level, even within the PBL by appropriately defining 'krel' & !
2275 ! 'prel' here. Then it must be accompanied by appropriate definition !
2276 ! of source air properties, CIN, and re-setting of 'fluxbelowinv', & !
2277 ! many other stuffs. !
2278 ! Note that even when 'prel' is located above the PBL top height, we !
2279 ! still have cumulus convection between PBL top height and 'prel': !
2280 ! we simply assume that no lateral mixing occurs in this range. !
2281 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------ !
2282
2283776458776458 if( klcl .lt. kinv ) then
2284321002321002 krel = kinv
2285 prel = ps0(krel-1)
2286 thv0rel = thv0bot(krel)
2287 else
2288455456455456 krel = klcl
2289 prel = plcl
2290 thv0rel = thv0lcl
2291 endif
2292
2293 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2294 ! Calculate cumulus base mass flux ('cbmf'), fractional area ('ufrcinv'), and !
2295 ! and mean vertical velocity (winv) of cumulus updraft at PBL top interface. !
2296 ! Also, calculate updraft fractional area (ufrclcl) and vertical velocity at !
2297 ! the LCL (wlcl). When LCL is below PBLH, cinlcl = 0 and 'ufrclcl = ufrcinv', !
2298 ! and 'wlcl = winv. !
2299 ! Only updrafts strong enough to overcome CIN can rise over PBL top interface.!
2300 ! Thus, in order to calculate cumulus mass flux at PBL top interface, 'cbmf',!
2301 ! we need to know 'CIN' ( the strength of potential energy barrier ) and !
2302 ! 'sigmaw' ( a standard deviation of updraft vertical velocity at the PBL top !
2303 ! interface, a measure of turbulentce strength in the PBL ). Naturally, the !
2304 ! ratio of these two variables, 'mu' - normalized CIN by TKE- is key variable !
2305 ! controlling 'cbmf'. If 'mu' becomes large, only small fraction of updrafts !
2306 ! with very strong TKE can rise over the PBL - both 'cbmf' and 'ufrc' becomes !
2307 ! small, but 'winv' becomes large ( this can be easily understood by PDF of w !
2308 ! at PBL top ). If 'mu' becomes small, lots of updraft can rise over the PBL !
2309 ! top - both 'cbmf' and 'ufrc' becomes large, but 'winv' becomes small. Thus, !
2310 ! all of the key variables associated with cumulus convection at the PBL top !
2311 ! - 'cbmf', 'ufrc', 'winv' where 'cbmf = rho*ufrc*winv' - are a unique functi !
2312 ! ons of 'mu', normalized CIN. Although these are uniquely determined by 'mu',!
2313 ! we usually impose two comstraints on 'cbmf' and 'ufrc': (1) because we will !
2314 ! simply assume that subsidence warming and drying of 'kinv-1' layer in assoc !
2315 ! iation with 'cbmf' at PBL top interface is confined only in 'kinv-1' layer, !
2316 ! cbmf must not be larger than the mass within the 'kinv-1' layer. Otherwise, !
2317 ! instability will occur due to the breaking of stability con. If we consider !
2318 ! semi-Lagrangian vertical advection scheme and explicitly consider the exten !
2319 ! t of vertical movement of each layer in association with cumulus mass flux, !
2320 ! we don't need to impose this constraint. However, using a semi-Lagrangian !
2321 ! scheme is a future research subject. Note that this constraint should be ap !
2322 ! plied for all interfaces above PBL top as well as PBL top interface. As a !
2323 ! result, this 'cbmf' constraint impose a 'lower' limit on mu - 'mumin0'. (2) !
2324 ! in order for mass flux parameterization - rho*(w'a')= M*(a_c-a_e) - to be !
2325 ! valid, cumulus updraft fractional area should be much smaller than 1. In !
2326 ! current code, we impose 'rmaxfrac = 0.1 ~ 0.2' through the whole vertical !
2327 ! layers where cumulus convection occurs. At the PBL top interface, the same !
2328 ! constraint is made by imposing another lower 'lower' limit on mu, 'mumin1'. !
2329 ! After that, also limit 'ufrclcl' to be smaller than 'rmaxfrac' by 'mumin2'. !
2330 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2331
2332 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2333 ! Calculate normalized CIN, 'mu' satisfying all the three constraints imposed !
2334 ! on 'cbmf'('mumin0'), 'ufrc' at the PBL top - 'ufrcinv' - ( by 'mumin1' from !
2335 ! a parameter sentence), and 'ufrc' at the LCL - 'ufrclcl' ( by 'mumin2'). !
2336 ! Note that 'cbmf' does not change between PBL top and LCL because we assume !
2337 ! that buoyancy sorting does not occur when cumulus updraft is unsaturated. !
2338 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2339
2340776458776458 if( use_CINcin ) then
2341776458776458 wcrit = sqrt( 2._r8 * cin * rbuoy )
2342 else
234300 wcrit = sqrt( 2._r8 * cinlcl * rbuoy )
2344 endif
2345776458776458 sigmaw = sqrt( rkfre * tkeavg + epsvarw )
2346 mu = wcrit/sigmaw/1.4142_r8
2347 if( mu .ge. 3._r8 ) then
2348 ! write(iulog,*) 'mu >= 3'
2349133233133233 id_exit = .true.
2350 go to 333
2351 endif
2352643225643225 rho0inv = ps0(kinv-1)/(r*thv0top(kinv-1)*exns0(kinv-1))
2353643225643225 cbmf = (rho0inv*sigmaw/2.5066_r8)*exp(-mu**2)
2354 ! 1. 'cbmf' constraint
2355 cbmflimit = 0.9_r8*dp0(kinv-1)/g/dt
2356 mumin0 = 0._r8
2357272103544206 if( cbmf .gt. cbmflimit ) mumin0 = sqrt(-log(2.5066_r8*cbmflimit/rho0inv/sigmaw))
2358 ! 2. 'ufrcinv' constraint
2359643225643225 mu = max(max(mu,mumin0),mumin1)
2360 ! 3. 'ufrclcl' constraint
2361643225643225 mulcl = sqrt(2._r8*cinlcl*rbuoy)/1.4142_r8/sigmaw
23626432251929675 mulclstar = sqrt(max(0._r8,2._r8*(exp(-mu**2)/2.5066_r8)**2*(1._r8/erfc(mu)**2-0.25_r8/rmaxfrac**2)))
2363325799325799 if( mulcl .gt. 1.e-8_r8 .and. mulcl .gt. mulclstar ) then
236469735139470 mumin2 = compute_mumin2(mulcl,rmaxfrac,mu)
2365 if( mu .gt. mumin2 ) then
236600 write(iulog,*) 'Critical error in mu calculation in UW_ShCu'
236700 call endrun
2368 endif
23696973569735 mu = max(mu,mumin2)
23706973569735 if( mu .eq. mumin2 ) limit_ufrc(i) = 1._r8
2371 endif
2372643225763984 if( mu .eq. mumin0 ) limit_cbmf(i) = 1._r8
2373643225771162 if( mu .eq. mumin1 ) limit_ufrc(i) = 1._r8
2374
2375 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2376 ! Calculate final ['cbmf','ufrcinv','winv'] at the PBL top interface. !
2377 ! Note that final 'cbmf' here is obtained in such that 'ufrcinv' and !
2378 ! 'ufrclcl' are smaller than ufrcmax with no instability. !
2379 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2380
23816432251286450 cbmf = (rho0inv*sigmaw/2.5066_r8)*exp(-mu**2)
23826432251929675 winv = sigmaw*(2._r8/2.5066_r8)*exp(-mu**2)/erfc(mu)
2383 ufrcinv = cbmf/winv/rho0inv
2384
2385 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2386 ! Calculate ['ufrclcl','wlcl'] at the LCL. When LCL is below PBL top, !
2387 ! it automatically becomes 'ufrclcl = ufrcinv' & 'wlcl = winv', since !
2388 ! it was already set to 'cinlcl=0' if LCL is below PBL top interface. !
2389 ! Note 'cbmf' at the PBL top is the same as 'cbmf' at the LCL. Note !
2390 ! also that final 'cbmf' here is obtained in such that 'ufrcinv' and !
2391 ! 'ufrclcl' are smaller than ufrcmax and there is no instability. !
2392 ! By construction, it must be 'wlcl > 0' but for assurance, I checked !
2393 ! this again in the below block. If 'ufrclcl < 0.1%', just exit. !
2394 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2395
2396 wtw = winv * winv - 2._r8 * cinlcl * rbuoy
2397 if( wtw .le. 0._r8 ) then
2398 ! write(iulog,*) 'wlcl < 0 at the LCL'
239900 exit_wtw(i) = 1._r8
2400 id_exit = .true.
2401 go to 333
2402 endif
2403643225643225 wlcl = sqrt(wtw)
2404 ufrclcl = cbmf/wlcl/rho0inv
2405 wrel = wlcl
2406 if( ufrclcl .le. 0.0001_r8 ) then
2407 ! write(iulog,*) 'ufrclcl <= 0.0001'
240873327332 exit_ufrc(i) = 1._r8
2409 id_exit = .true.
2410 go to 333
2411 endif
2412635893635893 ufrc(krel-1) = ufrclcl
2413
2414 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2415 ! Below is just diagnostic output for detailed analysis of cumulus scheme !
2416 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2417
2418 ufrcinvbase = ufrcinv
2419 winvbase = winv
24206799871951773 umf(kinv-1:krel-1) = cbmf
24216799871951773 wu(kinv-1:krel-1) = winv
2422
2423 ! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2424 ! Define updraft properties at the level where buoyancy sorting starts to be !
2425 ! happening, i.e., by definition, at 'prel' level within the release layer. !
2426 ! Because no lateral entrainment occurs upto 'prel', conservative scalars of !
2427 ! cumulus updraft at release level is same as those of source air. However, !
2428 ! horizontal momentums of source air are modified by horizontal PGF forcings !
2429 ! from PBL top interface to 'prel'. For this case, we should add additional !
2430 ! horizontal momentum from PBL top interface to 'prel' as will be done below !
2431 ! to 'usrc' and 'vsrc'. Note that below cumulus updraft properties - umf, wu,!
2432 ! thlu, qtu, thvu, uu, vu - are defined all interfaces not at the layer mid- !
2433 ! point. From the index notation of cumulus scheme, wu(k) is the cumulus up- !
2434 ! draft vertical velocity at the top interface of k layer. !
2435 ! Diabatic horizontal momentum forcing should be treated as a kind of 'body' !
2436 ! forcing without actual mass exchange between convective updraft and !
2437 ! environment, but still taking horizontal momentum from the environment to !
2438 ! the convective updrafts. Thus, diabatic convective momentum transport !
2439 ! vertically redistributes environmental horizontal momentum. !
2440 ! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2441
2442 !NOTE: The condensation call below appears to only impact the thermodynamics, and
2443 !thus does not probably need to be replicated. - JN.
2444
2445635893635893 emf(krel-1) = 0._r8
2446 umf(krel-1) = cbmf
2447 wu(krel-1) = wrel
2448 thlu(krel-1) = thlsrc
2449 qtu(krel-1) = qtsrc
2450635893635893 call conden(prel,thlsrc,qtsrc,thj,qvj,qlj,qij,qse,id_check,ncnst)
2451635893635893 if( id_check .eq. 1 ) then
245200 exit_conden(i) = 1._r8
2453 id_exit = .true.
2454 go to 333
2455 end if
2456635893635893 thvu(krel-1) = thj * ( 1._r8 + zvir*qvj - qlj - qij )
2457
2458 uplus = 0._r8
2459 vplus = 0._r8
2460 if( krel .eq. kinv ) then
2461598858598858 uplus = PGFc * ssu0(kinv) * ( prel - ps0(kinv-1) )
2462 vplus = PGFc * ssv0(kinv) * ( prel - ps0(kinv-1) )
2463 else
24644409481129 do k = kinv, max(krel-1,kinv)
2465 uplus = uplus + PGFc * ssu0(k) * ( ps0(k) - ps0(k-1) )
2466 vplus = vplus + PGFc * ssv0(k) * ( ps0(k) - ps0(k-1) )
2467 end do
24683703537035 uplus = uplus + PGFc * ssu0(krel) * ( prel - ps0(krel-1) )
2469 vplus = vplus + PGFc * ssv0(krel) * ( prel - ps0(krel-1) )
2470 end if
2471635893635893 uu(krel-1) = usrc + uplus
2472 vu(krel-1) = vsrc + vplus
2473
24743624590136245901 do m = 1, ncnst
2475 tru(krel-1,m) = trsrc(m) !<-Includes water tracers
2476 enddo

2479 !Water tracers
2480 !*************
2481635893635893 if(trace_water) then
248225435723179465 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
2483 wtu(krel-1,m) = wtsrc(m)
2484 end do
2485 end if

2488 ! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2489 ! Define environmental properties at the level where buoyancy sorting occurs !
2490 ! ('pe', normally, layer midpoint except in the 'krel' layer). In the 'krel' !
2491 ! layer where buoyancy sorting starts to occur, however, 'pe' is defined !
2492 ! differently because LCL is regarded as lower interface for mixing purpose. !
2493 ! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
2494
2495635893635893 pe = 0.5_r8 * ( prel + ps0(krel) )
2496 dpe = prel - ps0(krel)
24976358931271786 exne = exnf(pe)
2498 thvebot = thv0rel
2499 thle = thl0(krel) + ssthl0(krel) * ( pe - p0(krel) )
2500 qte = qt0(krel) + ssqt0(krel) * ( pe - p0(krel) )
2501 ue = u0(krel) + ssu0(krel) * ( pe - p0(krel) )
2502 ve = v0(krel) + ssv0(krel) * ( pe - p0(krel) )
25033624590136245901 do m = 1, ncnst
2504 tre(m) = tr0(krel,m) + sstr0(krel,m) * ( pe - p0(krel) )
2505 enddo

2508 !Water tracers
2509 !*************
2510635893635893 if(trace_water) then
251125435723179465 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
2512 wte(m) = wt0(krel,m) + sswt0(krel,m) * ( pe - p0(krel) )
2513 end do
2514 end if
