4328 !*************
4329 if(trace_water) then
4330862777210784715 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
4331 wlu_mid(m) = 0.5_r8 * ( wlubelow(m) + wtout(m,2) )
4332 wiu_mid(m) = 0.5_r8 * ( wiubelow(m) + wtout(m,3) )
4333 end do
4334 end if
4335 !*************
4336 endif
433754354855435485 qlubelow = qlj
4338 qiubelow = qij
4339
4340 !*************
4341 !Water tracers:
4342 !*************
4343 if(trace_water) then
43442174194032612910 wlubelow(:) = 0._r8
43452174194032612910 wiubelow(:) = 0._r8
43462174194027177425 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
4347 wlubelow(m) = wtout(m,2)
4348 wiubelow(m) = wtout(m,3)
4349 end do
4350 end if
4351 !*************
4352
4353 ! 1. Sustained Precipitation
4354
435554354855435485 qc_l(k) = ( 1._r8 - frc_rasn ) * dwten(k) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4356 qc_i(k) = ( 1._r8 - frc_rasn ) * diten(k) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4357
4358 !*************
4359 !Water tracers:
4360 !*************
43612174194021741940 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
4362 wtqc_liq(k,m) = ( 1._r8 - frc_rasn ) * wtdwten(k,m) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4363 wtqc_ice(k,m) = ( 1._r8 - frc_rasn ) * wtditen(k,m)
4364 end do
4365 !*************
4366
4367 ! 2. Detrained Condensate
4368
436954354855435485 if( k .le. kbup ) then
437047823974782397 qc_l(k) = qc_l(k) + g * 0.5_r8 * ( umf(k-1) + umf(k) ) * fdr(k) * qlu_mid ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4371 qc_i(k) = qc_i(k) + g * 0.5_r8 * ( umf(k-1) + umf(k) ) * fdr(k) * qiu_mid ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4372 qc_lm = - g * 0.5_r8 * ( umf(k-1) + umf(k) ) * fdr(k) * ql0(k)
4373 qc_im = - g * 0.5_r8 * ( umf(k-1) + umf(k) ) * fdr(k) * qi0(k)
4374 ! Below 'nc_lm', 'nc_im' should be used only when frc_rasn = 1.
4375 nc_lm = - g * 0.5_r8 * ( umf(k-1) + umf(k) ) * fdr(k) * tr0(k,ixnumliq)
4376 nc_im = - g * 0.5_r8 * ( umf(k-1) + umf(k) ) * fdr(k) * tr0(k,ixnumice)
4377 !*************
4378 !Water tracers:
4379 !*************
4380 if(trace_water) then
43811912958823911985 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
4382 wtqc_liq(k,m) = wtqc_liq(k,m)+ g * 0.5_r8 * &
4383 ( umf(k-1) + umf(k) ) * fdr(k) * wlu_mid(m) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4384 wtqc_ice(k,m) = wtqc_ice(k,m)+ g * 0.5_r8 * &
4385 ( umf(k-1) + umf(k) ) * fdr(k) * wiu_mid(m) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4386 wtqcm_liq(m)= - g * 0.5_r8 * ( umf(k-1) + umf(k) ) * fdr(k) * tr0(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq))
4387 wtqcm_ice(m)= - g * 0.5_r8 * ( umf(k-1) + umf(k) ) * fdr(k) * tr0(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice))
4388 end do
4389 end if
4390 !*************
4391 else
4392653088653088 qc_lm = 0._r8
4393 qc_im = 0._r8
4394 nc_lm = 0._r8
4395 nc_im = 0._r8
4396 !*************
4397 !Water tracers:
4398 !*************
4399 if(trace_water) then
440026123523918528 wtqcm_liq(:)= 0._r8
440126123523918528 wtqcm_ice(:)= 0._r8
4402 end if
4403 !*************
4404 endif
4405
4406 ! 3. Detached Updraft
4407
440854354855435485 if( k .eq. kbup ) then
4409587635587635 qc_l(k) = qc_l(k) + g * umf(k) * qlj / ( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) ) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4410 qc_i(k) = qc_i(k) + g * umf(k) * qij / ( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) ) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4411 qc_lm = qc_lm - g * umf(k) * ql0(k) / ( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) ) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4412 qc_im = qc_im - g * umf(k) * qi0(k) / ( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) ) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4413 nc_lm = nc_lm - g * umf(k) * tr0(k,ixnumliq) / ( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) ) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4414 nc_im = nc_im - g * umf(k) * tr0(k,ixnumice) / ( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) ) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4415 !*************
4416 !Water tracers:
4417 !*************
4418 if(trace_water) then
441923505402938175 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
4420 wtqc_liq(k,m) = wtqc_liq(k,m) + g * umf(k) * wtout(m,2) / ( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) ) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4421 wtqc_ice(k,m) = wtqc_ice(k,m) + g * umf(k) * wtout(m,3) / ( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) ) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4422 wtqcm_liq(m) = wtqcm_liq(m) - g * umf(k) * tr0(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) / ( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) ) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4423 wtqcm_ice(m) = wtqcm_ice(m) - g * umf(k) * tr0(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)) / ( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) ) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4424 end do
4425 end if
4426 !*************
4427 endif
4428
4429 ! 4. Cumulative Penetrative entrainment detrained in the 'kbup' layer
4430 ! Explicitly compute the properties detrained penetrative entrained airs in k = kbup layer.
4431
443254354855435485 if( k .eq. kbup ) then
4433587635587635 if(trace_water) then
4434705162013515605 wtout_emf_kbup(:,:) = 0.0_r8 !initalize variable (needed to prevent random tracer ice error) - JN
443523505405876350 call conden(p0(k),thlu_emf(k),qtu_emf(k),thj,qvj,ql_emf_kbup,qi_emf_kbup,qse,id_check,wtrc_nwset,&
4436 qv0=qtu_emf(k),tr0=wtu_emf(k,:),wtout=wtout_emf_kbup)
4437 else
443800 call conden(p0(k),thlu_emf(k),qtu_emf(k),thj,qvj,ql_emf_kbup,qi_emf_kbup,qse,id_check,ncnst)
4439 end if
4440587635587635 if( id_check .eq. 1 ) then
444100 id_exit = .true.
4442 go to 333
4443 endif
4444587635587635 if( ql_emf_kbup .gt. 0._r8 ) then
444547474747 nl_emf_kbup = tru_emf(k,ixnumliq)
4446 else
4447582888582888 nl_emf_kbup = 0._r8
4448 endif
4449587635587635 if( qi_emf_kbup .gt. 0._r8 ) then
445036953695 ni_emf_kbup = tru_emf(k,ixnumice)
4451 else
4452583940583940 ni_emf_kbup = 0._r8
4453 endif
4454587635587635 qc_lm = qc_lm - g * emf(k) * ( ql_emf_kbup - ql0(k) ) / ( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) ) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4455 qc_im = qc_im - g * emf(k) * ( qi_emf_kbup - qi0(k) ) / ( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) ) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4456 nc_lm = nc_lm - g * emf(k) * ( nl_emf_kbup - tr0(k,ixnumliq) ) / ( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) ) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4457 nc_im = nc_im - g * emf(k) * ( ni_emf_kbup - tr0(k,ixnumice) ) / ( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) ) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4458 !*************
4459 !Water tracers:
4460 !*************
4461 if(trace_water) then
446223505402938175 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
4463 wtqcm_liq(m) = wtqcm_liq(m) - g * emf(k) * ( wtout_emf_kbup(m,2) - tr0(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) ) / &
4464 ( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) ) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4465 wtqcm_ice(m) = wtqcm_ice(m) - g * emf(k) * ( wtout_emf_kbup(m,3) - tr0(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)) ) / &
4466 ( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) ) ! [ kg/kg/s ]
4467 end do
4468 end if
4469 !*************
4470 endif
4471
447254354855435485 qlten_det = qc_l(k) + qc_lm
4473 qiten_det = qc_i(k) + qc_im
4474
4475 !*************
4476 !Water tracers:
4477 !*************
4478 if(trace_water) then
44792174194027177425 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
4480 wtlten_det(k,m) = wtqc_liq(k,m) + wtqcm_liq(m)
4481 wtiten_det(k,m) = wtqc_ice(k,m) + wtqcm_ice(m)
4482 end do
4483 end if
4484 !*************
4485
4486 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4487 ! 'qlten(k)','qiten(k)','qvten(k)','sten(k)' !
4488 ! Note that falling of precipitation will be treated later. !
4489 ! The prevension of negative 'qv,ql,qi' will be treated later in positive_moisture. !
4490 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4491
449254354855435485 if( use_expconten ) then
449354354855435485 if( use_unicondet ) then
4494 qc_l(k) = 0._r8
4495 qc_i(k) = 0._r8
4496 qlten(k) = frc_rasn * dwten(k) + qlten_sink(k) + qlten_det
4497 qiten(k) = frc_rasn * diten(k) + qiten_sink(k) + qiten_det
4498 !*************
4499 !Water tracers:
4500 !*************
450100 if(trace_water) then
450200 wtqc_liq(k,:) = 0._r8 !Set "reserved" liquid to zero?
450300 wtqc_ice(k,:) = 0._r8
450400 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
4505 trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) = frc_rasn * wtdwten(k,m) + &
4506 wtten_sink_liq(k,m) + wtlten_det(k,m)
4507 trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)) = frc_rasn * wtditen(k,m) + &
4508 wtten_sink_ice(k,m) + wtiten_det(k,m)
4509 end do
4510 end if
4511 !*************
4512 else
451354354855435485 qlten(k) = qc_l(k) + frc_rasn * dwten(k) + ( max( 0._r8, ql0(k) + &
4514 ( qc_lm + qlten_sink(k) ) * dt ) - ql0(k) ) / dt
4515 qiten(k) = qc_i(k) + frc_rasn * diten(k) + ( max( 0._r8, qi0(k) + &
4516 ( qc_im + qiten_sink(k) ) * dt ) - qi0(k) ) / dt
4517 trten(k,ixnumliq) = max( nc_lm + nlten_sink(k), - tr0(k,ixnumliq) / dt )
4518 trten(k,ixnumice) = max( nc_im + niten_sink(k), - tr0(k,ixnumice) / dt )
4519 !*************
4520 !water tracers:
4521 !*************
4522 if(trace_water) then
45232174194027177425 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
4524 trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) = wtqc_liq(k,m) + frc_rasn * wtdwten(k,m) + &
4525 ( max( 0._r8, tr0(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) + ( wtqcm_liq(m) + &
4526 wtten_sink_liq(k,m) ) * dt ) - &
4527 tr0(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) ) / dt
4528 trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)) = wtqc_ice(k,m) + frc_rasn * wtditen(k,m) + &
4529 ( max( 0._r8, tr0(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)) + ( wtqcm_ice(m) + &
4530 wtten_sink_ice(k,m) ) * dt ) - &
4531 tr0(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)) ) / dt
4532 end do
4533 end if
4534 !*************
4535 endif
4536 else
453700 if( use_unicondet ) then
4538 qc_l(k) = 0._r8
4539 qc_i(k) = 0._r8
4540 !water tracers:
4541 !*************
454200 if(trace_water) then
454300 wtqc_liq(k,:) = 0._r8
454400 wtqc_ice(k,:) = 0._r8
4545 end if
4546 !*************
4547 endif
454800 qlten(k) = dwten(k) + ( qtten(k) - dwten(k) - diten(k) ) * ( ql0(k) / qt0(k) )
4549 qiten(k) = diten(k) + ( qtten(k) - dwten(k) - diten(k) ) * ( qi0(k) / qt0(k) )
4550 !*************
4551 !water tracers:
4552 !*************
4553
4554 !NOTE: Not sure if summing up the tendencies is the same as calculating qtten for
4555 !water tracers. If this section of code is found to be producing bad values, then
4556 !this summation is the most-likely cause.
4557 if(trace_water) then
455800 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
4559 trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) = wtdwten(k,m) + ( wttotten(k,m) - wtdwten(k,m) - &
4560 wtditen(k,m) ) * (tr0(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) / wt0(k,m))
4561 trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)) = wtditen(k,m) + ( wttotten(k,m) - wtdwten(k,m) - &
4562 wtditen(k,m) ) * (tr0(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)) / wt0(k,m))
4563 end do
4564 end if
4565 !*************
4566 endif
4567
456854354855435485 qvten(k) = qtten(k) - qlten(k) - qiten(k)
4569 sten(k) = slten(k) + xlv * qlten(k) + xls * qiten(k)
4570
4571 !*************************************
4572 !Calculate water tracer vapor tendency:
4573 !*************************************
4574 if(trace_water) then
45752174194027177425 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
4576 trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = wttotten(k,m) - trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) - trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice))
4577 end do
4578 end if
4579 !**************************************
4580
4581 ! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4582 ! 'rliq' : Verticall-integrated 'suspended cloud condensate' !
4583 ! [m/s] This is so called 'reserved liquid water' in other subroutines !
4584 ! of CAM3, since the contribution of this term should not be included into !
4585 ! the tendency of each layer or surface flux (precip) within this cumulus !
4586 ! scheme. The adding of this term to the layer tendency will be done inthe !
4587 ! 'stratiform_tend', just after performing sediment process there. !
4588 ! The main problem of these rather going-back-and-forth and stupid-seeming !
4589 ! approach is that the sediment process of suspendened condensate will not !
4590 ! be treated at all in the 'stratiform_tend'. !
4591 ! Note that 'precip' [m/s] is vertically-integrated total 'rain+snow' formed !
4592 ! from the cumulus updraft. Important : in the below, 1000 is rhoh2o ( water !
4593 ! density ) [ kg/m^3 ] used for unit conversion from [ kg/m^2/s ] to [ m/s ] !
4594 ! for use in stratiform.F90. !
4595 ! -------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4596
4597 qc(k) = qc_l(k) + qc_i(k)
4598 rliq = rliq + qc(k) * dp0(k) / g / 1000._r8 ! [ m/s ]
4599
4600 end do
4601
4602587635587635 precip = rainflx + snowflx ! [ kg/m2/s ]
4603 snow = snowflx ! [ kg/m2/s ]
4604
4605 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------- !
4606 ! Now treats the 'evaporation' and 'melting' of rain ( qrten ) and !
4607 ! snow ( qsten ) during falling process. Below algorithms are from !
4608 ! 'zm_conv_evap' but with some modification, which allows separate !
4609 ! treatment of 'rain' and 'snow' condensates. Note that I included !
4610 ! the evaporation dynamics into the convection scheme for complete !
4611 ! development of cumulus scheme especially in association with the !
4612 ! implicit CIN closure. In compatible with this internal treatment !
4613 ! of evaporation, I should modify 'convect_shallow', in such that !
4614 ! 'zm_conv_evap' is not performed when I choose UW PBL-Cu schemes. !
4615 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------- !
4616
4617 evpint_rain = 0._r8
4618 evpint_snow = 0._r8
46191821668519391955 flxrain(0:mkx) = 0._r8
46201821668519391955 flxsnow(0:mkx) = 0._r8
46211762905018804320 ntraprd(:mkx) = 0._r8
46221762905018804320 ntsnprd(:mkx) = 0._r8
4623 !Water tracers:
4624 !*************
4625587635587635 if(trace_water) then
46267286674081093630 wtflxrn(0:mkx,:) = 0._r8
46277286674081093630 wtflxsn(0:mkx,:) = 0._r8
4628 end if
4629
46301762905018216685 do k = mkx, 1, -1 ! 'k' is a layer index : 'mkx'('1') is the top ('bottom') layer
4631
4632 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4633 ! flxsntm [kg/m2/s] : Downward snow flux at the top of each layer after melting.!
4634 ! snowmlt [kg/kg/s] : Snow melting tendency. !
4635 ! Below allows melting of snow when it goes down into the warm layer below. !
4636 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4637
46381762905017629050 if( t0(k) .gt. 273.16_r8 ) then
463948146234814623 snowmlt = max( 0._r8, flxsnow(k) * g / dp0(k) )
4640 else
46411281442712814427 snowmlt = 0._r8
4642 endif
4643
4644 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
4645 ! Evaporation rate of 'rain' and 'snow' in the layer k, [ kg/kg/s ] !
4646 ! where 'rain' and 'snow' are coming down from the upper layers. !
4647 ! I used the same evaporative efficiency both for 'rain' and 'snow'.!
4648 ! Note that evaporation is not allowed in the layers 'k >= krel' by !
4649 ! assuming that inside of cumulus cloud, across which precipitation !
4650 ! is falling down, is fully saturated. !
4651 ! The asumptions in association with the 'evplimit_rain(snow)' are !
4652 ! 1. Do not allow evaporation to supersate the layer !
4653 ! 2. Do not evaporate more than the flux falling into the layer !
4654 ! 3. Total evaporation cannot exceed the input total surface flux !
4655 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
4656
46571762905017629050 call qsat(t0(k), p0(k), es, qs)
46581762905017629050 subsat = max( ( 1._r8 - qv0(k)/qs ), 0._r8 )
4659 if( noevap_krelkpen ) then
466000 if( k .ge. krel ) subsat = 0._r8
4661 endif
4662
46631762905017629050 evprain = kevp * subsat * sqrt(flxrain(k)+snowmlt*dp0(k)/g)
46641762905017629050 evpsnow = kevp * subsat * sqrt(max(flxsnow(k)-snowmlt*dp0(k)/g,0._r8))
4665
4666 evplimit = max( 0._r8, ( qw0_in(i,k) - qv0(k) ) / dt )
4667
4668 evplimit_rain = min( evplimit, ( flxrain(k) + snowmlt * dp0(k) / g ) * g / dp0(k) )
4669 evplimit_rain = min( evplimit_rain, ( rainflx - evpint_rain ) * g / dp0(k) )
4670 evprain = max(0._r8,min( evplimit_rain, evprain ))
4671
4672 evplimit_snow = min( evplimit, max( flxsnow(k) - snowmlt * dp0(k) / g , 0._r8 ) * g / dp0(k) )
4673 evplimit_snow = min( evplimit_snow, ( snowflx - evpint_snow ) * g / dp0(k) )
4674 evpsnow = max(0._r8,min( evplimit_snow, evpsnow ))
4675
4676 if( ( evprain + evpsnow ) .gt. evplimit ) then
467700 tmp1 = evprain * evplimit / ( evprain + evpsnow )
4678 tmp2 = evpsnow * evplimit / ( evprain + evpsnow )
4679 evprain = tmp1
4680 evpsnow = tmp2
4681 endif
4682
46831762905017629050 evapc(k) = evprain + evpsnow
4684
4685 ! ------------------------------------------------------------- !
4686 ! Vertically-integrated evaporative fluxes of 'rain' and 'snow' !
4687 ! ------------------------------------------------------------- !
4688
4689 evpint_rain = evpint_rain + evprain * dp0(k) / g
4690 evpint_snow = evpint_snow + evpsnow * dp0(k) / g
4691
4692 ! -------------------------------------------------------------- !
4693 ! Net 'rain' and 'snow' production rate in the layer [ kg/kg/s ] !
4694 ! -------------------------------------------------------------- !
4695
4696 ntraprd(k) = qrten(k) - evprain + snowmlt
4697 ntsnprd(k) = qsten(k) - evpsnow - snowmlt
4698
4699 ! -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4700 ! Downward fluxes of 'rain' and 'snow' fluxes at the base of the layer [ kg/m2/s ] !
4701 ! Note that layer index increases with height. !
4702 ! -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4703
4704 flxrain(k-1) = flxrain(k) + ntraprd(k) * dp0(k) / g
4705 flxsnow(k-1) = flxsnow(k) + ntsnprd(k) * dp0(k) / g
4706 flxrain(k-1) = max( flxrain(k-1), 0._r8 )
47071355193713551937 if( flxrain(k-1) .eq. 0._r8 ) ntraprd(k) = -flxrain(k) * g / dp0(k)
47081762905017629050 flxsnow(k-1) = max( flxsnow(k-1), 0._r8 )
47091717547317175473 if( flxsnow(k-1) .eq. 0._r8 ) ntsnprd(k) = -flxsnow(k) * g / dp0(k)
4710
4711 ! ---------------------------------- !
4712 ! Calculate thermodynamic tendencies !
4713 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4714 ! Note that equivalently, we can write tendency formula of 'sten' and 'slten' !
4715 ! by 'sten(k) = sten(k) - xlv*evprain - xls*evpsnow - (xls-xlv)*snowmlt' & !
4716 ! 'slten(k) = sten(k) - xlv*qlten(k) - xls*qiten(k)'. !
4717 ! The above formula is equivalent to the below formula. However below formula !
4718 ! is preferred since we have already imposed explicit constraint on 'ntraprd' !
4719 ! and 'ntsnprd' in case that flxrain(k-1) < 0 & flxsnow(k-1) < 0._r8 !
4720 ! Note : In future, I can elborate the limiting of 'qlten','qvten','qiten' !
4721 ! such that that energy and moisture conservation error is completely !
4722 ! suppressed. !
4723 ! Re-storation to the positive condensate will be performed later below !
4724 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4725
47261762905017629050 qlten(k) = qlten(k) - qrten(k)
4727 qiten(k) = qiten(k) - qsten(k)
4728 qvten(k) = qvten(k) + evprain + evpsnow
4729 qtten(k) = qlten(k) + qiten(k) + qvten(k)
47301762904435256637 if( ( qv0(k) + qvten(k)*dt ) .lt. qmin(1) .or. &
4731 ( ql0(k) + qlten(k)*dt ) .lt. qmin(ixcldliq) .or. &
4732 ( qi0(k) + qiten(k)*dt ) .lt. qmin(ixcldice) ) then
47331109011090 limit_negcon(i) = 1._r8
4734 end if
47351762905017629050 sten(k) = sten(k) - xlv*evprain - xls*evpsnow - (xls-xlv)*snowmlt
4736 slten(k) = sten(k) - xlv*qlten(k) - xls*qiten(k)
4737
4738 ! slten(k) = slten(k) + xlv * ntraprd(k) + xls * ntsnprd(k)
4739 ! sten(k) = slten(k) + xlv * qlten(k) + xls * qiten(k)
4740
4741 !***************************************************
4742 !Water tracers precipitation re-evaporation
4743 !***************************************************
4744 if(trace_water) then
4745
4746 !NOTE: The precipitation evaporation code was taken almost directly
4747 !from the wtrc_precip_evap subroutine. So, if there is a way to call
4748 !the routine from here, it might reduce code redundancy. - JN
4749
4750 !Diffusivity ratios and powers (should be called from water_isotopes.F90 eventually):
475170516200105774300 difrm = (/ 1._r8, 1._r8, 0.9836504_r8, 0.9686999_r8 /) ! kinetic theory
47521762905017629050 dkfac = 0.58_r8 ! From Stewart, 1975?
4753
4754 !phi value given in Bony et. al., 2008:
4755 phi = 0.9_r8
4756
4757 !Assumed raindrop radius:
4758 ! rain_radius = 0.00065_r8
4759
4760 !Calculate layer thickness:
4761 dz(k) = zs0(k) - zs0(k-1)
4762
47637051620070516200 do m=1,wtrc_nwset !Loop over water species
4764
4765 !Calculate precipitation and water vapor ratios:
47667051620070516200 if(k .eq. mkx) then !At top of layer?
476723505404701080 Rr = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)),wtrpten(k,m),wtrpten(k,1)) !Use rain production
476823505404701080 Rs = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)),wtspten(k,m),wtspten(k,1)) !Use snow production
4769 else
47706816566068165660 if(wtflxrn(k,1) .ne. 0._r8) then !is there actual rain here?
47711452308829046176 Rr = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)),wtflxrn(k,m),wtflxrn(k,1))
4772 else !If not, just use local production.
477353642572107285144 Rr = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)),wtrpten(k,m),wtrpten(k,1)) !Use rain production
4774 end if
47756816566068165660 if(wtflxsn(k,1) .ne. 0._r8) then !is there actual snow here?
477618001363600272 Rs = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)),wtflxsn(k,m),wtflxsn(k,1))
4777 else
477866365524132731048 Rs = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)),wtspten(k,m),wtspten(k,1)) !Use snow production
4779 end if
4780 end if
4781
4782 !Water tracer vapor ratio:
478370516200141032400 Rv = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),tr0(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),&
4784 tr0(k,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap)))
4785
478670516200123403350 if(wisotope .and. (m .gt. 1) .and. (wtflxrn(k,1) .gt. 0._r8)) then !Are water isotopes being used and not H2O or H216O, and is precip present?
4787
4788 !calculate equilibrium alpha:
47891089231610892316 ispec = iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) !water isotope species
4790
4791 !fractionation factor:
47921089231621784632 alpliq = wtrc_get_alpha(qv0(k),t0(k),ispec,iwtvap,iwtliq,.false.,1._r8,.false.)
4793
4794 !calculate kinetic alpha:
47951089231621784632 alpkin = (1._r8/difrm(ispec))**dkfac
4796
4797 !calculate effective humidity:
4798 heff = phi+((1._r8-phi)*(qv0(k)/qs)) !From Bony et. al., 2008
4799
4800 !calculate fraction of rain that evaporated:
4801 fr = (wtflxrn(k,1)-(evprain*dp0(k)/g))/wtflxrn(k,1)
4802
4803 !constrain ratio fraction:
4804 fr = min(1._r8,max(0._r8,fr))
4805
4806 !calculate raindrop radius based off rain rate:
4807 !NOTE: mean diameter in mm = 4/(4.1*R^-0.21), with R in mm/hr, assuming
4808 !a Marshall-Palmer distribution. -JN
48091089231621784632 rain_radius = 2._r8/(4.1_r8*(wtflxrn(k,1)*60._r8*60._r8)** (-0.21_r8))
4810
4811 !convert radius to meters:
4812 rain_radius = rain_radius/1000._r8
4813
4814 !calculate fraction equilibrated:
48151089231610892316 call wtrc_equil_time(ispec,t0(k),p0(k),rain_radius,dz(k),alpliq,difrm(ispec),fequil)
4816
4817 !constrain equilibration fraction:
48181089231610892316 fequil = min(1._r8,max(0._r8,fequil))
4819
4820 !if((heff .lt. 1._r8) .and. (fr .lt. 1._r8)) then !Is the air un-saturated?
4821 if(.false.) then !Only equilibrate when using wtrc_equil_time. -JN
4822 !Stewart, 1975:
4823 !calculate parameters
4824 gam = (alpliq*heff)/(1._r8-alpliq*alpkin*(1._r8-heff))
4825 bet = (1._r8-alpliq*alpkin*(1._r8-heff))/(alpliq*alpkin*(1._r8-heff))
4826
4827 !Calculate new rain ratio applying Stewart, 1975 equation:
482800 Rstw = gam*Rv + (Rr - gam*Rv)*fr**bet
4829
4830 !apply epsilon:
4831 Re = fequil*Rstw + (1._r8-fequil)*Rr
4832
483300 if((fr .eq. 0._r8) .and. (bet .lt. 0._r8)) then !preven NaNs (plus there shouldn't be any evaporation anyways)
483400 wtevp(k,m) = evprain*Rr
4835 else !If evaporation does occur, then
4836 !Set evaporation to equal mass loss:
483700 if(dp0(k) .gt. 0._r8) then !prevent NaNs
483800 wtevp(k,m) = (wtflxrn(k,m) - Re*(wtflxrn(k,1)-(wtevp(k,1)*dp0(k)/g)))*g/dp0(k)
4839 else
484000 wtevp(k,m) = evprain*Rr !Just conserve ratio if there is a NaN risk
4841 end if
4842 end if
4843 else
4844 !NOTE: This evp below should always be zero. If not, then at least it will match the bulk water
4845 !(even if its physically incorrect) - JN
48461089231610892316 wtevp(k,m) = evprain*Rr
4847
4848 !calculate liquid-vapor equilibrium:
4849 ivtmp = tr0(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))+wtevp(k,m)*dt !set temporary storage variables
4850 iltmp = ((wtflxrn(k,m)*g/dp0(k))-wtevp(k,m))*dt !convert to kg/kg
4851 vtmp = tr0(k,wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap))+wtevp(k,1)*dt
4852 ltmp = ((wtflxrn(k,1)*g/dp0(k))-wtevp(k,1))*dt !convert to kg/kg
48531089231610892316 call wtrc_liqvap_equil(alpliq, fequil, vtmp, ltmp, ivtmp, iltmp, dliqiso)
48541089231610892316 wtevp(k,m) = wtevp(k,m) - dliqiso/dt !add tendency to evaporation
4855 end if
4856 else
48575962388459623884 wtevp(k,m) = evprain*Rr !Keep tracer proportional
4858 end if
4859
4860 !Calculate snow sublimation (No fractionation occurs during sublimation):
48617051620070516200 wtsub(k,m) = evpsnow*Rs
4862
4863 !Calculate snow melt
4864 if( t0(k) .gt. 273.16_r8 ) then
48651925849219258492 wtsnwmlt = max( 0._r8, wtflxsn(k,m) * g / dp0(k) )
4866 else
48675125770851257708 wtsnwmlt = 0._r8
4868 endif
4869
4870 !Modify precipitation:
4871 wtflxrn(k-1,m) = wtflxrn(k,m) + (wtrpten(k,m) - wtevp(k,m) + wtsnwmlt) * dp0(k) / g
4872 wtflxsn(k-1,m) = wtflxsn(k,m) + (wtspten(k,m) - wtsub(k,m) - wtsnwmlt) * dp0(k) / g
4873
4874 !Prevent negative precipitation:
4875 wtflxrn(k-1,m) = max(wtflxrn(k-1,m), 0._r8)
4876 wtflxsn(k-1,m) = max(wtflxsn(k-1,m), 0._r8)
4877
4878 !Modify tendencies:
4879 trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) = trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) - wtrpten(k,m)
4880 trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)) = trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)) - wtspten(k,m)
4881 trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) + wtevp(k,m) + wtsub(k,m)
4882
4883 end do !Water species
4884 end if !water tracers?
4885 !*****************************************************************
4886
4887 end do !vertical levels (k)
4888
4889 ! ------------------------------------------------------------- !
4890 ! Calculate final surface flux of precipitation, rain, and snow !
4891 ! Convert unit to [m/s] for use in 'check_energy_chng'. !
4892 ! ------------------------------------------------------------- !
4893
4894587635587635 precip = ( flxrain(0) + flxsnow(0) ) / 1000._r8
4895 snow = flxsnow(0) / 1000._r8
4896
4897 !*************
4898 !Water tracers
4899 !*************
4900 if(trace_water) then
490123505402938175 do m=1,wtrc_nwset
490223505402350540 wtprec(m) = ( wtflxrn(0,m) + wtflxsn(0,m) ) / 1000._r8
4903 wtsnow(m) = wtflxsn(0,m) / 1000._r8
4904 !----------
4905 !Mass fixer:
4906 !----------
490717629051762905 if((m .gt. 1) .and. (wtprec(m) .gt. 2._r8*wtprec(1))) then
490838513851 if(wtprec(1) .gt. 1e-18_r8) &
490900 write(*,*) 'ERROR: Isotopic shallow-conv precip error!',wtprec(m),wtprec(1),wtsnow(m),wtsnow(1),m
4910 ! wtprec(m) = wtprec(1)
4911 ! wtsnow(m) = wtsnow(1)
4912 end if
4913 !-----------
4914 end do
4915 end if
4916 !*************
4917
4918 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4919 ! Until now, all the calculations are done completely in this shallow cumulus !
4920 ! scheme. If you want to use this cumulus scheme other than CAM3, then do not !
4921 ! perform below block. However, for compatible use with the other subroutines !
4922 ! in CAM3, I should subtract the effect of 'qc(k)' ('rliq') from the tendency !
4923 ! equation in each layer, since this effect will be separately added later in !
4924 ! in 'stratiform_tend' just after performing sediment process there. In order !
4925 ! to be consistent with 'stratiform_tend', just subtract qc(k) from tendency !
4926 ! equation of each layer, but do not add it to the 'precip'. Apprently, this !
4927 ! will violate energy and moisture conservations. However, when performing !
4928 ! conservation check in 'tphysbc.F90' just after 'convect_shallow_tend', we !
4929 ! will add 'qc(k)' ( rliq ) to the surface flux term just for the purpose of !
4930 ! passing the energy-moisture conservation check. Explicit adding-back of 'qc'!
4931 ! to the individual layer tendency equation will be done in 'stratiform_tend' !
4932 ! after performing sediment process there. Simply speaking, in 'tphysbc' just !
4933 ! after 'convect_shallow_tend', we will dump 'rliq' into surface as a 'rain' !
4934 ! in order to satisfy energy and moisture conservation, and in the following !
4935 ! 'stratiform_tend', we will restore it back to 'qlten(k)' ( 'ice' will go to !
4936 ! 'water' there) from surface precipitation. This is a funny but conceptually !
4937 ! entertaining procedure. One concern I have for this complex process is that !
4938 ! output-writed stratiform precipitation amount will be underestimated due to !
4939 ! arbitrary subtracting of 'rliq' in stratiform_tend, where !
4940 ! ' prec_str = prec_sed + prec_pcw - rliq' and 'rliq' is not real but fake. !
4941 ! However, as shown in 'srfxfer.F90', large scale precipitation amount (PRECL)!
4942 ! that is writed-output is corrected written since in 'srfxfer.F90', PRECL = !
4943 ! 'prec_sed + prec_pcw', without including 'rliq'. So current code is correct.!
4944 ! Note also in 'srfxfer.F90', convective precipitation amount is 'PRECC = !
4945 ! prec_zmc(i) + prec_cmf(i)' which is also correct. !
4946 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4947
494854354856023120 do k = 1, kpen
494954354855435485 qtten(k) = qtten(k) - qc(k)
4950 qlten(k) = qlten(k) - qc_l(k)
4951 qiten(k) = qiten(k) - qc_i(k)
4952 slten(k) = slten(k) + ( xlv * qc_l(k) + xls * qc_i(k) )
4953 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4954 ! Since all reserved condensates will be treated as liquid water in the !
4955 ! 'check_energy_chng' & 'stratiform_tend' without an explicit conversion !
4956 ! algorithm, I should consider explicitly the energy conversions between !
4957 ! 'ice' and 'liquid' - i.e., I should convert 'ice' to 'liquid' and the !
4958 ! necessary energy for this conversion should be subtracted from 'sten'. !
4959 ! Without this conversion here, energy conservation error come out. Note !
4960 ! that there should be no change of 'qvten(k)'. !
4961 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------------- !
4962 sten(k) = sten(k) - ( xls - xlv ) * qc_i(k)
4963
4964 !***************
4965 !Water tracers:
4966 !***************
4967 if(trace_water) then
49682174194027177425 do m=1,wtrc_nwset !Loop over water species
4969 trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) = trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq))-wtqc_liq(k,m)
4970 trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)) = trten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice))-wtqc_ice(k,m)
4971 end do
4972 end if
4973 !***************
4974
4975 end do
4976
4977 ! --------------------------------------------------------------- !
4978 ! Prevent the onset-of negative condensate at the next time step !
4979 ! Potentially, this block can be moved just in front of the above !
4980 ! block. !
4981 ! --------------------------------------------------------------- !
4982
4983 ! Modification : I should check whether this 'positive_moisture_single' routine is
4984 ! consistent with the one used in UW PBL and cloud macrophysics schemes.
4985 ! Modification : Below may overestimate resulting 'ql, qi' if we use the new 'qc_l', 'qc_i'
4986 ! in combination with the original computation of qlten, qiten. However,
4987 ! if we use new 'qlten,qiten', there is no problem.
4988
49891762905018804320 qv0_star(:mkx) = qv0(:mkx) + qvten(:mkx) * dt
49901762905018804320 ql0_star(:mkx) = ql0(:mkx) + qlten(:mkx) * dt
49911762905018804320 qi0_star(:mkx) = qi0(:mkx) + qiten(:mkx) * dt
49921762905018804320 s0_star(:mkx) = s0(:mkx) + sten(:mkx) * dt
4993 !*************
4994 !water tracers:
4995 !*************
4996587635587635 if(trace_water) then
4997211548600239167445 wt0_star(:,:,:) = 0._r8 !initalize variable
499823505402938175 do m=1, wtrc_nwset !Loop over water species
49997051620075217280 wt0_star(:mkx,m,1) = tr0(:mkx,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) + trten(:mkx,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) * dt
50007051620075217280 wt0_star(:mkx,m,2) = tr0(:mkx,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) + trten(:mkx,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) * dt
50017051620075217280 wt0_star(:mkx,m,3) = tr0(:mkx,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)) + trten(:mkx,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)) * dt
5002 end do
5003587635587635 call positive_moisture_single( xlv, xls, mkx, dt, qmin(1), qmin(ixcldliq), &
5004 qmin(ixcldice), dp0, qv0_star, ql0_star, qi0_star, s0_star, &
5005 qvten, qlten, qiten, sten, ncnst, wtr=wt0_star, wtten=trten )
5006 else
500700 call positive_moisture_single( xlv, xls, mkx, dt, qmin(1), qmin(ixcldliq), qmin(ixcldice), &
5008 dp0, qv0_star, ql0_star, qi0_star, s0_star, qvten, qlten, qiten, sten, ncnst )
5009 end if !water tracers
5010 !************
50111762905018804320 qtten(:mkx) = qvten(:mkx) + qlten(:mkx) + qiten(:mkx)
50121762905018804320 slten(:mkx) = sten(:mkx) - xlv * qlten(:mkx) - xls * qiten(:mkx)
5013
5014 ! --------------------- !
5015 ! Tendencies of tracers !
5016 ! --------------------- !
5017
50183173229032319925 do m = 4, ncnst
5019
5020 !Do not modify water tracers here.
5021
502231732290125166255 if( m .ne. ixnumliq .and. m .ne. ixnumice .and. (.not. wtrc_is_wtrc(m))) then
5023
50241410324014103240 trmin = qmin(m)
5025437200440465406920 trflx_d(0:mkx) = 0._r8
5026437200440465406920 trflx_u(0:mkx) = 0._r8
5027408993960423097200 do k = 1, mkx-1
5028408993960817987920 if( cnst_get_type_byind(m) .eq. 'wet' ) then
50296816566068165660 pdelx = dp0(k)
5030 else
5031340828300340828300 pdelx = dpdry0(k)
5032 endif
5033 km1 = k - 1
5034 dum = ( tr0(k,m) - trmin ) * pdelx / g / dt + trflx(km1,m) - trflx(k,m) + trflx_d(km1)
5035 trflx_d(k) = min( 0._r8, dum )
5036 enddo
5037408993960423097200 do k = mkx, 2, -1
5038408993960817987920 if( cnst_get_type_byind(m) .eq. 'wet' ) then
50396816566068165660 pdelx = dp0(k)
5040 else
5041340828300340828300 pdelx = dpdry0(k)
5042 endif
5043 km1 = k - 1
5044 dum = ( tr0(k,m) - trmin ) * pdelx / g / dt + trflx(km1,m) - trflx(k,m) + &
5045 trflx_d(km1) - trflx_d(k) - trflx_u(k)
5046 trflx_u(km1) = max( 0._r8, -dum )
5047 enddo
5048423097200437200440 do k = 1, mkx
5049423097200846194400 if( cnst_get_type_byind(m) .eq. 'wet' ) then
50507051620070516200 pdelx = dp0(k)
5051 else
5052352581000352581000 pdelx = dpdry0(k)
5053 endif
5054 km1 = k - 1
5055 ! Check : I should re-check whether '_u', '_d' are correctly ordered in
5056 ! the below tendency computation.
5057 trten(k,m) = ( trflx(km1,m) - trflx(k,m) + &
5058 trflx_d(km1) - trflx_d(k) + &
5059 trflx_u(km1) - trflx_u(k) ) * g / pdelx
5060 enddo
5061
5062 endif
5063
5064 enddo

5066 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------- !
5067 ! Cumpute default diagnostic outputs !
5068 ! Note that since 'qtu(krel-1:kpen-1)' & 'thlu(krel-1:kpen-1)' has !
5069 ! been adjusted after detraining cloud condensate into environment !
5070 ! during cumulus updraft motion, below calculations will exactly !
5071 ! reproduce in-cloud properties as shown in the output analysis. !
5072 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------- !
5073
5074 !NOTE: This section of code is solely for diagnostic output, which doesn't impact water tracers. - JN
5075
5076587635587635 call conden(prel,thlu(krel-1),qtu(krel-1),thj,qvj,qlj,qij,qse,id_check,ncnst)
5077587635587635 if( id_check .eq. 1 ) then
507800 exit_conden(i) = 1._r8
5079 id_exit = .true.
5080 go to 333
5081 end if
5082587635587635 qcubelow = qlj + qij
5083 qlubelow = qlj
5084 qiubelow = qij
5085 rcwp = 0._r8
5086 rlwp = 0._r8
5087 riwp = 0._r8
5088
5089 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------- !
5090 ! In the below calculations, I explicitly considered cloud base ( LCL ) !
5091 ! and cloud top height ( ps0(kpen-1) + ppen ) !
5092 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------!
509333322133332213 do k = krel, kpen ! This is a layer index
5094 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------ !
5095 ! Calculate cumulus condensate at the upper interface of each layer. !
5096 ! Note 'ppen < 0' and at 'k=kpen' layer, I used 'thlu_top'&'qtu_top' !
5097 ! which explicitly considered zero or non-zero 'fer(kpen)'. !
5098 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------ !
509933322133332213 if( k .eq. kpen ) then
5100587635587635 call conden(ps0(k-1)+ppen,thlu_top,qtu_top,thj,qvj,qlj,qij,qse,id_check,ncnst)
5101 else
510227445782744578 call conden(ps0(k),thlu(k),qtu(k),thj,qvj,qlj,qij,qse,id_check,ncnst)
5103 endif
510433322133332213 if( id_check .eq. 1 ) then
510500 exit_conden(i) = 1._r8
5106 id_exit = .true.
5107 go to 333
5108 end if
5109 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------- !
5110 ! Calculate in-cloud mean LWC ( qlu(k) ), IWC ( qiu(k) ), & layer !
5111 ! mean cumulus fraction ( cufrc(k) ), vertically-integrated layer !
5112 ! mean LWP and IWP. Expel some of in-cloud condensate at the upper !
5113 ! interface if it is largr than criqc. Note cumulus cloud fraction !
5114 ! is assumed to be twice of core updraft fractional area. Thus LWP !
5115 ! and IWP will be twice of actual value coming from our scheme. !
5116 ! ---------------------------------------------------------------- !
511733322133332213 qcu(k) = 0.5_r8 * ( qcubelow + qlj + qij )
5118 qlu(k) = 0.5_r8 * ( qlubelow + qlj )
5119 qiu(k) = 0.5_r8 * ( qiubelow + qij )
5120 cufrc(k) = ( ufrc(k-1) + ufrc(k) )
5121 if( k .eq. krel ) then
5122587635587635 cufrc(k) = ( ufrclcl + ufrc(k) )*( prel - ps0(k) )/( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) )
512327445782744578 else if( k .eq. kpen ) then
5124587635587635 cufrc(k) = ( ufrc(k-1) + 0._r8 )*( -ppen ) /( ps0(k-1) - ps0(k) )
5125 if( (qlj + qij) .gt. criqc ) then
5126164276164276 qcu(k) = 0.5_r8 * ( qcubelow + criqc )
5127 qlu(k) = 0.5_r8 * ( qlubelow + criqc * qlj / ( qlj + qij ) )
5128 qiu(k) = 0.5_r8 * ( qiubelow + criqc * qij / ( qlj + qij ) )

566550365335036533 subroutine getbuoy(pbot,thv0bot,ptop,thv0top,thvubot,thvutop,plfc,cin)
5666 ! ----------------------------------------------------------- !
5667 ! Subroutine to calculate integrated CIN [ J/kg = m2/s2 ] and !
5668 ! 'cinlcl, plfc' if any. Assume 'thv' is linear in each layer !
5669 ! both for cumulus and environment. Note that this subroutine !
5670 ! only include positive CIN in calculation - if there are any !
5671 ! negative CIN, it is assumed to be zero. This is slightly !
5672 ! different from 'single_cin' below, where both positive and !
5673 ! negative CIN are included. !
5674 ! ----------------------------------------------------------- !
5675 real(r8) pbot,thv0bot,ptop,thv0top,thvubot,thvutop,plfc,cin,frc
5676
567750365335200035 if( thvubot .gt. thv0bot .and. thvutop .gt. thv0top ) then
5678150640150640 plfc = pbot
5679 return
568048858939758924 elseif( thvubot .le. thv0bot .and. thvutop .le. thv0top ) then
568142355804235580 cin = cin - ( (thvubot/thv0bot - 1._r8) + (thvutop/thv0top - 1._r8)) * (pbot - ptop) / &
568242355808471160 ( pbot/(r*thv0bot*exnf(pbot)) + ptop/(r*thv0top*exnf(ptop)) )
5683650313663175 elseif( thvubot .gt. thv0bot .and. thvutop .le. thv0top ) then
56841286212862 frc = ( thvutop/thv0top - 1._r8 ) / ( (thvutop/thv0top - 1._r8) - (thvubot/thv0bot - 1._r8) )
56851286212862 cin = cin - ( thvutop/thv0top - 1._r8 ) * ( (ptop + frc*(pbot - ptop)) - ptop ) / &
56861286225724 ( pbot/(r*thv0bot*exnf(pbot)) + ptop/(r*thv0top*exnf(ptop)) )
5687 else
5688637451637451 frc = ( thvubot/thv0bot - 1._r8 ) / ( (thvubot/thv0bot - 1._r8) - (thvutop/thv0top - 1._r8) )
5689 plfc = pbot - frc * ( pbot - ptop )
5690637451637451 cin = cin - ( thvubot/thv0bot - 1._r8)*(pbot - plfc)/ &
56916374511274902 ( pbot/(r*thv0bot*exnf(pbot)) + ptop/(r*thv0top * exnf(ptop)))
5692 endif
5693
5694 return
569550365335036533 end subroutine getbuoy
5696
5697803179803179 function single_cin(pbot,thv0bot,ptop,thv0top,thvubot,thvutop)
5698 ! ------------------------------------------------------- !
5699 ! Function to calculate a single layer CIN by summing all !
5700 ! positive and negative CIN. !
5701 ! ------------------------------------------------------- !
5702 real(r8) :: single_cin
5703 real(r8) pbot,thv0bot,ptop,thv0top,thvubot,thvutop
5704
5705803179803179 single_cin = ( (1._r8 - thvubot/thv0bot) + (1._r8 - thvutop/thv0top)) * ( pbot - ptop ) / &
57068031791606358 ( pbot/(r*thv0bot*exnf(pbot)) + ptop/(r*thv0top*exnf(ptop)) )
5707 return
5708803179803179 end function single_cin

57113454836834548368 subroutine roots(a,b,c,r1,r2,status)
5712 ! --------------------------------------------------------- !
5713 ! Subroutine to solve the second order polynomial equation. !
5714 ! I should check this subroutine later. !
5715 ! --------------------------------------------------------- !
5716 real(r8), intent(in) :: a
5717 real(r8), intent(in) :: b
5718 real(r8), intent(in) :: c
5719 real(r8), intent(out) :: r1
5720 real(r8), intent(out) :: r2
5721 integer , intent(out) :: status
5722 real(r8) :: q
5723
57243454836834548368 status = 0
5725
5726 if( a .eq. 0._r8 ) then ! Form b*x + c = 0
572700 if( b .eq. 0._r8 ) then ! Failure: c = 0
572800 status = 1
5729 else ! b*x + c = 0
573000 r1 = -c/b
5731 endif
573200 r2 = r1
5733 else
57343454836834548368 if( b .eq. 0._r8 ) then ! Form a*x**2 + c = 0
573500 if( a*c .gt. 0._r8 ) then ! Failure: x**2 = -c/a < 0
573600 status = 2
5737 else ! x**2 = -c/a
573800 r1 = sqrt(-c/a)
5739 endif
574000 r2 = -r1
5741 else ! Form a*x**2 + b*x + c = 0
57423454836834548368 if( (b**2 - 4._r8*a*c) .lt. 0._r8 ) then ! Failure, no real roots
574300 status = 3
5744 else
574534548368138193472 q = -0.5_r8*(b + sign(1.0_r8,b)*sqrt(b**2 - 4._r8*a*c))
5746 r1 = q/a
5747 r2 = c/q
5748 endif
5749 endif
5750 endif
5751
5752 return
57533454836834548368 end subroutine roots

5756196103480196103480 subroutine conden(p,thl,qt,th,qv,ql,qi,rvls,id_check,ncnst,qv0,tr0,wtout)
5757 ! --------------------------- !
5758 !water tracer use statements
5759 ! --------------------------- !
5760 use water_tracer_vars, only : trace_water, wisotope, wtrc_iatype, iwspec, wtrc_nwset
5761 use water_tracers, only : wtrc_ratio, wtrc_get_alpha
5762 use water_types, only : iwtvap, iwtliq, iwtice
5763 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------- !
5764 ! Calculate thermodynamic properties from a given set of ( p, thl, qt ) !
5765 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------- !
5766 implicit none
5767 real(r8), intent(in) :: p
5768 real(r8), intent(in) :: thl
5769 real(r8), intent(in) :: qt
5770
5771 real(r8), intent(out) :: th
5772 real(r8), intent(out) :: qv
5773 real(r8), intent(out) :: ql
5774 real(r8), intent(out) :: qi
5775 real(r8), intent(out) :: rvls
5776 integer , intent(out) :: id_check
5777
5778 !Needed for water tracer output:
5779 !------------------------------
5780 integer, intent(in) :: ncnst !number of constituents for ratio input
5781 real(r8), intent(in), optional :: qv0 !input bulk-water used for ratio calculations
5782 real(r8), intent(in), optional :: tr0(ncnst) !environmental tracers pre-condensation
5783 real(r8), intent(inout), optional :: wtout(wtrc_nwset,3) !water tracer output (1=vapor, 2=liquid, 3=ice)
5784 !------------------------------
5785
5786 real(r8) :: tc,temps,t
5787 real(r8) :: leff, nu, qc
5788 integer :: iteration
5789 real(r8) :: es ! Saturation vapor pressure
5790 real(r8) :: qs ! Saturation spec. humidity
5791
5792 !Needed for water tracer calculations:
5793 !************************************
5794 real(r8) :: Rv0 !Initial water tracer vapor ratio
5795 real(r8) :: Rv !Final water tracer vapor ratio
5796 real(r8) :: Rl !Final water tracer condensate (liquid) ratio
5797 real(r8) :: Rve !Final water tracer vapor ratio for equilibrium
5798 real(r8) :: Rle !Final water tracer liquid ratio for equilibrium
5799 real(r8) :: Rvr !Final water tracer vapor ratio for Rayleigh
5800 real(r8) :: Rlr !Final water tracer liquid ratio for Rayleigh
5801 real(r8) :: ae !Equilibrium fractionation factor
5802 real(r8) :: fv !Fraction of vapor left after condensation.
5803 real(r8) :: rh !relative humidity
5804 real(r8) :: tavg !average temperature during phase change.
5805 integer :: m !Loop control variable
5806 !************************************
5807
5808196103480392206960 tc = thl*exnf(p)
5809 ! Modification : In order to be compatible with the dlf treatment in stratiform.F90,
5810 ! we may use ( 268.15, 238.15 ) with 30K ramping instead of 20 K,
5811 ! in computing ice fraction below.
5812 ! Note that 'cldwat_fice' uses ( 243.15, 263.15 ) with 20K ramping for stratus.
5813 nu = max(min((268._r8 - tc)/20._r8,1.0_r8),0.0_r8) ! Fraction of ice in the condensate.
5814 leff = (1._r8 - nu)*xlv + nu*xls ! This is an estimate that hopefully speeds convergence
5815
5816 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
5817 ! Below "temps" and "rvls" are just initial guesses for iteration loop below. !
5818 ! Note that the output "temps" from the below iteration loop is "temperature" !
5819 ! NOT "liquid temperature". !
5820 ! --------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
5821
5822 temps = tc
5823196103480196103480 call qsat(temps, p, es, qs)
5824196103480196103480 rvls = qs
5825
5826 if( qs .ge. qt ) then
58277991962279919622 id_check = 0
5828 qv = qt
5829 qc = 0._r8
5830 ql = 0._r8
5831 qi = 0._r8
583279919622159839244 th = tc/exnf(p)
5833 else
583411618385801278022438 do iteration = 1, 10
583511618385801161838580 temps = temps + ( (tc-temps)*cp/leff + qt - rvls )/( cp/leff + ep2*leff*rvls/r/temps/temps )
583611618385801161838580 call qsat(temps, p, es, qs)
5837 rvls = qs
5838 end do
5839116183858116183858 qc = max(qt - qs,0._r8)
5840 qv = qt - qc
5841 ql = qc*(1._r8 - nu)
5842 qi = nu*qc
5843116183858232367716 th = temps/exnf(p)
5844 if( abs((temps-(leff/cp)*qc)-tc) .ge. 1._r8 ) then
584500 id_check = 1
5846 else
5847116183858116183858 id_check = 0
5848 end if
5849
5850 !**************************************************
5851 !Water tracer/Isotope code:
5852 !**************************************************
5853116183858464735432 if(trace_water .and. present(wtout)) then
5854
5855 !NOTE: The current temperature used to calculate the fractionation
5856 !factors is simply the average between the initial temperature and
5857 !the temperature post-condensation. If this subroutine is producing
5858 !incorrect isotope values, then this could possibly be the reason. - JN
5859
5860 !NOTE: Might need to modify temperature cutoffs later, especially for mixed-phase clouds. - JN
5861 !NOTE: May need to compare Bony's "effective" fractionation factor for ice against using
5862 !the standard get_alpha call with kinetic fractionation allowed. - JN
5863
5864 !------------
5865 !Physics note
5866 !------------
5867 !This code currently assumes that all liquid forms directly from vapor,
5868 !and that all ice also forms directly from vapor. However, in reality
5869 !this is not always the case, as ice can form via freezing liquid, and
5870 !liquid can form from melting ice. Eventually a choice should be made
5871 !as to which microphysics assumption produces the most realistic isotopic
5872 !values, but it might just need to be noted that this assumption
5873 !encompasses the fact the convective parameterizations in CAM are limited,
5874 !and thus will simply be unable to resolve these details. - JN.
5875 !------------------
5876
5877 !Calculate the average temperature during the phase-change:
58782388012123880121 tavg = (tc + temps)/2._r8
5879
5880 !Calculate Isotope ratios (from Bony et. al., 2008):
58819552048495520484 do m=1,wtrc_nwset !Loop over isotopes:
58829552048495520484 if(ncnst > wtrc_nwset) then !Are the input arrays dimensioned for all consitutents?
588300 Rv0 = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),tr0(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),tr0(wtrc_iatype(1,iwtvap)))
5884 else !Are the input arrays dimensioned just for water tracers?
588595520484573122904 Rv0 = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),tr0(m),tr0(1))
5886 end if
58879552048495520484 if(wisotope) then !Are you using isotopic physics?
58889552048495520484 if(qv0 .ne. 0._r8) then !prevent NaNs?
58899552048495520484 fv = qv/qv0 !fraction of vapor remaining.
5890 else
589100 fv = 1._r8 !if at risk for NaN, just assume unity
5892 end if
589395520484191040968 ae = wtrc_get_alpha(qv,tavg,iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),iwtvap,iwtliq,.false.,1._r8) !get equilibrium fractionation factor
5894 if(ae-fv*(ae-1._r8) .ne. 0._r8) then !prevent NaNs
58959552048495520484 Rve = Rv0/(ae-fv*(ae-1._r8)) !calculate new Rv value (for fraction that will become liquid)
5896 Rle = ae*Rve !Assume liquid is in equil. with vapor.
5897 Rve = Rve*(1._r8-nu) !have ratio represent only liquid condensate
5898 Rle = Rle*(1._r8-nu)
5899 else
590000 Rve = Rv0*(1._r8-nu) !if at risk for NaN, just conserve ratio !UNCOMMENT LATER!
5901 Rle = Rv0*(1._r8-nu)
5902 end if
59039552048495520484 if(fv .ne. 1._r8) then !prevent NaNs
59049552048495520484 rh = qv/qs !calculate relative humidity
590595520484191040968 ae = wtrc_get_alpha(qv,tavg,iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),iwtvap,iwtice,.false.,rh) !get kinetic*equilibrium fract. factor
590695520484191040968 Rvr = Rv0*(fv**(ae-1._r8)) !calculate new Rv value (assume Rayleigh distillation for fraction that will become ice)
5907 Rlr = (Rv0-fv*Rvr)/(1._r8-fv) !calculate new Rl value (assume Rayleigh distillation)
5908 Rvr = Rvr*nu !have ratio represent only ice condensate
5909 Rlr = Rlr*nu
5910 else
591100 Rvr = Rv0*nu !if at risk for NaN, just conserve ratio !UNCOMMENT LATER!
5912 Rlr = Rv0*nu
5913 end if
59149552048495520484 Rv = Rve+Rvr !combine into final Rv and Rl
5915 Rl = Rle+Rlr
5916 else
591700 Rv = Rv0 !assume ratios stay constant if water isotopes are off.
5918 Rl = Rv0
5919 end if
5920
5921 !Adjust values according to water tracer ratios:
5922 wtout(m,1) = Rv*qv !Water vapor
5923 wtout(m,2) = (Rl*qc)*(1._r8-nu) !Cloud liquid
5924 wtout(m,3) = nu*(Rl*qc) !Cloud ice
5925
5926 end do !water species
5927 end if !water tracers
5928 !*****************************************
5929
5930 end if !(super-)saturation
5931
5932 return
5933196103480196103480 end subroutine conden
5934
59356518980965189809 function slope(mkx,field,p0)
5936 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------ !
5937 ! Function performing profile reconstruction of conservative scalars !
5938 ! in each layer. This is identical to profile reconstruction used in !
5939 ! UW-PBL scheme but from bottom to top layer here. At the lowest !
5940 ! layer near to surface, slope is defined using the two lowest layer !
5941 ! mid-point values. I checked this subroutine and it is correct. !
5942 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------ !
5943 integer, intent(in) :: mkx
5944 real(r8) :: slope(mkx)
5945 real(r8), intent(in) :: field(mkx)
5946 real(r8), intent(in) :: p0(mkx)
5947
5948 real(r8) :: below
5949 real(r8) :: above
5950 integer :: k
5951
5952 below = ( field(2) - field(1) ) / ( p0(2) - p0(1) )
595318905044611890504461 do k = 2, mkx
595418905044611890504461 above = ( field(k) - field(k-1) ) / ( p0(k) - p0(k-1) )
5955 if( above .gt. 0._r8 ) then
595610047747551004774755 slope(k-1) = max(0._r8,min(above,below))
5957 else
5958885729706885729706 slope(k-1) = min(0._r8,max(above,below))
5959 end if
5960 below = above
5961 end do
59626518980965189809 slope(mkx) = slope(mkx-1)
5963
5964 return
59656518980965189809 end function slope
5966
5967935201935201 function qsinvert(qt,thl,psfc)
5968 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
5969 ! Function calculating saturation pressure ps (or pLCL) from qt and !
5970 ! thl ( liquid potential temperature, NOT liquid virtual potential !
5971 ! temperature) by inverting Bolton formula. I should check later if !
5972 ! current use of 'leff' instead of 'xlv' here is reasonable or not. !
5973 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------- !
5974 real(r8) :: qsinvert
5975 real(r8) qt, thl, psfc
5976 real(r8) ps, Pis, Ts, err, dlnqsdT, dTdPis
5977 real(r8) dPisdps, dlnqsdps, derrdps, dps
5978 real(r8) Ti, rhi, TLCL, PiLCL, psmin, dpsmax
5979 integer i
5980 real(r8) :: es ! saturation vapor pressure
5981 real(r8) :: qs ! saturation spec. humidity
5982 real(r8) :: gam ! (L/cp)*dqs/dT
5983 real(r8) :: leff, nu
5984
5985935201935201 psmin = 100._r8*100._r8 ! Default saturation pressure [Pa] if iteration does not converge
5986 dpsmax = 1._r8 ! Tolerance [Pa] for convergence of iteration
5987
5988 ! ------------------------------------ !
5989 ! Calculate best initial guess of pLCL !
5990 ! ------------------------------------ !
5991
59929352011870402 Ti = thl*(psfc/p00)**rovcp
5993935201935201 call qsat(Ti, psfc, es, qs)
5994935201935201 rhi = qt/qs
5995 if( rhi .le. 0.01_r8 ) then
599600 write(iulog,*) 'Source air is too dry and pLCL is set to psmin in uwshcu.F90'
599700 qsinvert = psmin
5998 return
5999 end if
60009352011870402 TLCL = 55._r8 + 1._r8/(1._r8/(Ti-55._r8)-log(rhi)/2840._r8); ! Bolton's formula. MWR.1980.Eq.(22)
6001 PiLCL = TLCL/thl
60029352011870402 ps = p00*(PiLCL)**(1._r8/rovcp)
6003
600414373591437359 do i = 1, 10
600523725604745120 Pis = (ps/p00)**rovcp
6006 Ts = thl*Pis
600723725602372560 call qsat(Ts, ps, es, qs, gam=gam)
600823725602372560 err = qt - qs
6009 nu = max(min((268._r8 - Ts)/20._r8,1.0_r8),0.0_r8)
6010 leff = (1._r8 - nu)*xlv + nu*xls
6011 dlnqsdT = gam*(cp/leff)/qs
6012 dTdPis = thl
6013 dPisdps = rovcp*Pis/ps
6014 dlnqsdps = -1._r8/(ps - (1._r8 - ep2)*es)
6015 derrdps = -qs*(dlnqsdT * dTdPis * dPisdps + dlnqsdps)
6016 dps = -err/derrdps
6017 ps = ps + dps
6018 if( ps .lt. 0._r8 ) then
601900 write(iulog,*) 'pLCL iteration is negative and set to psmin in uwshcu.F90', qt, thl, psfc
602000 qsinvert = psmin
6021 return
6022 end if
602323725602372560 if( abs(dps) .le. dpsmax ) then
6024935201935201 qsinvert = ps
6025 return
6026 end if
6027 end do
602800 write(iulog,*) 'pLCL does not converge and is set to psmin in uwshcu.F90', qt, thl, psfc
602900 qsinvert = psmin
6030 return
6031935201935201 end function qsinvert
6032
6033286832286832 real(r8) function compute_alpha(del_CIN,ke)
6034 ! ------------------------------------------------ !
6035 ! Subroutine to compute proportionality factor for !
6036 ! implicit CIN calculation. !
6037 ! ------------------------------------------------ !
6038 real(r8) :: del_CIN, ke
6039 real(r8) :: x0, x1
6040
6041 integer :: iteration
6042
6043286832286832 x0 = 0._r8
604428683202868320 do iteration = 1, 10
604528683202868320 x1 = x0 - (exp(-x0*ke*del_CIN) - x0)/(-ke*del_CIN*exp(-x0*ke*del_CIN) - 1._r8)
6046 x0 = x1
6047 end do
6048286832286832 compute_alpha = x0
6049
6050 return
6051
6052286832286832 end function compute_alpha
6053
60546973569735 real(r8) function compute_mumin2(mulcl,rmaxfrac,mulow)
6055 ! --------------------------------------------------------- !
6056 ! Subroutine to compute critical 'mu' (normalized CIN) such !
6057 ! that updraft fraction at the LCL is equal to 'rmaxfrac'. !
6058 ! --------------------------------------------------------- !
6059 real(r8) :: mulcl, rmaxfrac, mulow
6060 real(r8) :: x0, x1, ex, ef, exf, f, fs
6061 integer :: iteration
6062
60636973569735 x0 = mulow
6064697350697350 do iteration = 1, 10
60656973501394700 ex = exp(-x0**2)
60666973501394700 ef = erfc(x0)
6067 ! if(x0.ge.3._r8) then
6068 ! compute_mumin2 = 3._r8
6069 ! goto 20
6070 ! endif
6071 exf = ex/ef
6072 f = 0.5_r8*exf**2 - 0.5_r8*(ex/2._r8/rmaxfrac)**2 - (mulcl*2.5066_r8/2._r8)**2
6073 fs = (2._r8*exf**2)*(exf/sqrt(3.141592_r8)-x0) + (0.5_r8*x0*ex**2)/(rmaxfrac**2)
6074 x1 = x0 - f/fs
6075 x0 = x1
6076 end do
60776973569735 compute_mumin2 = x0
6078
6079 20 return
6080
60816973569735 end function compute_mumin2
6082
6083840931840931 real(r8) function compute_ppen(wtwb,D,bogbot,bogtop,rho0j,dpen)
6084 ! ----------------------------------------------------------- !
6085 ! Subroutine to compute critical 'ppen[Pa]<0' ( pressure dis. !
6086 ! from 'ps0(kpen-1)' to the cumulus top where cumulus updraft !
6087 ! vertical velocity is exactly zero ) by considering exact !
6088 ! non-zero fer(kpen). !
6089 ! ----------------------------------------------------------- !
6090 real(r8) :: wtwb, D, bogbot, bogtop, rho0j, dpen
6091 real(r8) :: x0, x1, f, fs, SB, s00
6092 integer :: iteration
6093
6094 ! Buoyancy slope
6095840931840931 SB = ( bogtop - bogbot ) / dpen
6096 ! Sign of slope, 'f' at x = 0
6097 ! If 's00>0', 'w' increases with height.
6098 s00 = bogbot / rho0j - D * wtwb
6099
6100 if( D*dpen .lt. 1.e-8_r8 ) then
61016666 if( s00 .ge. 0._r8 ) then
610233 x0 = dpen
6103 else
61046363 x0 = max(0._r8,min(dpen,-0.5_r8*wtwb/s00))
6105 endif
6106 else
6107840865840865 if( s00 .ge. 0._r8 ) then
61086583965839 x0 = dpen
6109 else
6110775026775026 x0 = 0._r8
6111 endif
611242043255045190 do iteration = 1, 5
611342043254204325 f = exp(-2._r8*D*x0)*(wtwb-(bogbot-SB/(2._r8*D))/(D*rho0j)) + &
6114 (SB*x0+bogbot-SB/(2._r8*D))/(D*rho0j)
611542043254204325 fs = -2._r8*D*exp(-2._r8*D*x0)*(wtwb-(bogbot-SB/(2._r8*D))/(D*rho0j)) + &
6116 (SB)/(D*rho0j)
6117 if( fs .ge. 0._r8 ) then
611800 fs = max(fs, 1.e-10_r8)
6119 else
612042043254204325 fs = min(fs,-1.e-10_r8)
6121 endif
6122 x1 = x0 - f/fs
6123 x0 = x1
6124 end do
6125
6126 endif
6127
6128840931840931 compute_ppen = -max(0._r8,min(dpen,x0))
6129
6130840931840931 end function compute_ppen
6131
61323819627538196275 subroutine fluxbelowinv(cbmf,ps0,mkx,kinv,dt,xsrc,xmean,xtopin,xbotin,xflx)
6133 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
6134 ! Subroutine to calculate turbulent fluxes at and below 'kinv-1' interfaces.!
6135 ! Check in the main program such that input 'cbmf' should not be zero. !
6136 ! If the reconstructed inversion height does not go down below the 'kinv-1' !
6137 ! interface, then turbulent flux at 'kinv-1' interface is simply a product !
6138 ! of 'cmbf' and 'qtsrc-xbot' where 'xbot' is the value at the top interface !
6139 ! of 'kinv-1' layer. This flux is linearly interpolated down to the surface !
6140 ! assuming turbulent fluxes at surface are zero. If reconstructed inversion !
6141 ! height goes down below the 'kinv-1' interface, subsidence warming &drying !
6142 ! measured by 'xtop-xbot', where 'xtop' is the value at the base interface !
6143 ! of 'kinv+1' layer, is added ONLY to the 'kinv-1' layer, using appropriate !
6144 ! mass weighting ( rpinv and rcbmf, or rr = rpinv / rcbmf ) between current !
6145 ! and next provisional time step. Also impose a limiter to enforce outliers !
6146 ! of thermodynamic variables in 'kinv' layer to come back to normal values !
6147 ! at the next step. !
6148 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
6149 integer, intent(in) :: mkx, kinv
6150 real(r8), intent(in) :: cbmf, dt, xsrc, xmean, xtopin, xbotin
6151 real(r8), intent(in), dimension(0:mkx) :: ps0
6152 real(r8), intent(out), dimension(0:mkx) :: xflx
6153 integer k
6154 real(r8) rcbmf, rpeff, dp, rr, pinv_eff, xtop, xbot, pinv, xtop_ori, xbot_ori
6155
615611840845251260477075 xflx(0:mkx) = 0._r8
61573819627538196275 dp = ps0(kinv-1) - ps0(kinv)
6158 xbot = xbotin
6159 xtop = xtopin
6160
6161 ! -------------------------------------- !
6162 ! Compute reconstructed inversion height !
6163 ! -------------------------------------- !
6164 xtop_ori = xtop
6165 xbot_ori = xbot
6166 rcbmf = ( cbmf * g * dt ) / dp ! Can be larger than 1 : 'OK'
6167
6168 if( xbot .ge. xtop ) then
61692520372225203722 rpeff = ( xmean - xtop ) / max( 1.e-20_r8, xbot - xtop )
6170 else
61711299255312992553 rpeff = ( xmean - xtop ) / min( -1.e-20_r8, xbot - xtop )
6172 endif
6173
61743819627538196275 rpeff = min( max(0._r8,rpeff), 1._r8 ) ! As of this, 0<= rpeff <= 1
61753011017730110177 if( rpeff .eq. 0._r8 .or. rpeff .eq. 1._r8 ) then
61761247657012476570 xbot = xmean
6177 xtop = xmean
6178 endif
6179 ! Below two commented-out lines are the old code replacing the above 'if' block.
6180 ! if(rpeff.eq.1) xbot = xmean
6181 ! if(rpeff.eq.0) xtop = xmean
61823819627538196275 rr = rpeff / rcbmf
6183 pinv = ps0(kinv-1) - rpeff * dp ! "pinv" before detraining mass
6184 pinv_eff = ps0(kinv-1) + ( rcbmf - rpeff ) * dp ! Effective "pinv" after detraining mass
6185 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------- !
6186 ! Compute turbulent fluxes. !
6187 ! Below two cases exactly converges at 'kinv-1' interface when rr = 1._r8 !
6188 ! ----------------------------------------------------------------------- !
6189172253640172253640 do k = 0, kinv - 1
6190 xflx(k) = cbmf * ( xsrc - xbot ) * ( ps0(0) - ps0(k) ) / ( ps0(0) - pinv )
6191 end do
61923819627538196275 if( rr .le. 1._r8 ) then
61931846169518461695 xflx(kinv-1) = xflx(kinv-1) - ( 1._r8 - rr ) * cbmf * ( xtop_ori - xbot_ori )
6194 endif
6195
6196 return
61973819627538196275 end subroutine fluxbelowinv
6198
61995876351175270 subroutine positive_moisture_single( xlv, xls, mkx, dt, qvmin, qlmin, qimin, dp, qv, ql, qi, s, qvten, qlten, qiten, sten, &
6200 ncnst, wtr, wtten )
6201 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
6202 ! If any 'ql < qlmin, qi < qimin, qv < qvmin' are developed in any layer, !
6203 ! force them to be larger than minimum value by (1) condensating water vapor !
6204 ! into liquid or ice, and (2) by transporting water vapor from the very lower !
6205 ! layer. '2._r8' is multiplied to the minimum values for safety. !
6206 ! Update final state variables and tendencies associated with this correction. !
6207 ! If any condensation happens, update (s,t) too. !
6208 ! Note that (qv,ql,qi,s) are final state variables after applying corresponding !
6209 ! input tendencies and corrective tendencies !
6210 ! ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- !
6211 ! --------------------------- !
6212 !water tracer use statements
6213 ! --------------------------- !
6214 use water_tracer_vars, only : trace_water, wisotope, wtrc_iatype, iwspec, wtrc_nwset
6215 use water_tracers, only : wtrc_ratio, wtrc_get_rstd
6216 use water_types, only : iwtvap, iwtliq, iwtice
6217 ! --------------------------- !
6218
6219 implicit none
6220 integer, intent(in) :: mkx
6221 real(r8), intent(in) :: xlv, xls
6222 real(r8), intent(in) :: dt, qvmin, qlmin, qimin
6223 real(r8), intent(in) :: dp(mkx)
6224 real(r8), intent(inout) :: qv(mkx), ql(mkx), qi(mkx), s(mkx)
6225 real(r8), intent(inout) :: qvten(mkx), qlten(mkx), qiten(mkx), sten(mkx)
6226 integer k,m
6227 real(r8) dql, dqi, dqv, sum, aa, dum
6228
6229 !water tracers:
6230 integer, intent(in) :: ncnst !number of constitutents
6231 real(r8), intent(inout), optional :: wtr(mkx,wtrc_nwset,3) !Water tracer state (1=vapor, 2=liquid, 3=ice)
6232 real(r8), intent(inout), optional :: wtten(mkx,ncnst) !Water tracer tendency
6233 real(r8) :: wtr0(mkx,wtrc_nwset,3)!Original water tracer values
6234 real(r8) Rv !Water tracer ratios
6235
62365876351175270 if(present(wtr)) then
6237211548600239167445 wtr0(:,:,:) = wtr(:,:,:) !initalize storage variable - JN
6238 end if
6239
62401762905018216685 do k = mkx, 1, -1 ! From the top to the 1st (lowest) layer from the surface
62411762905017629050 dql = max(0._r8,1._r8*qlmin-ql(k))
6242 dqi = max(0._r8,1._r8*qimin-qi(k))
6243 qlten(k) = qlten(k) + dql/dt
6244 qiten(k) = qiten(k) + dqi/dt
6245 qvten(k) = qvten(k) - (dql+dqi)/dt
6246 sten(k) = sten(k) + xlv * (dql/dt) + xls * (dqi/dt)
6247 ql(k) = ql(k) + dql
6248 qi(k) = qi(k) + dqi
6249 qv(k) = qv(k) - dql - dqi
6250 s(k) = s(k) + xlv * dql + xls * dqi
6251 dqv = max(0._r8,1._r8*qvmin-qv(k))
6252 qvten(k) = qvten(k) + dqv/dt
6253 qv(k) = qv(k) + dqv
6254 if( k .ne. 1 ) then
62551704141517041415 qv(k-1) = qv(k-1) - dqv*dp(k)/dp(k-1)
6256 qvten(k-1) = qvten(k-1) - dqv*dp(k)/dp(k-1)/dt
6257 endif
62581762905017629050 qv(k) = max(qv(k),qvmin)
6259 ql(k) = max(ql(k),qlmin)
6260 qi(k) = max(qi(k),qimin)
6261 !************************************************
6262 !Modify water tracers in the same way, multiplied
6263 !by their tracer ratio:
6264 !
6265 !NOTE: This code modifies moisture by producing
6266 !condensation, which means that some sort of
6267 !isotopic fractionation should occur. However,
6268 !this whole subroutine seems a little, for lack
6269 !of a better word, arbitrary, and thus for now
6270 !will simply be modified by the ratios. Still,
6271 !if this scheme does not produce the correct
6272 !isotope values, the lack of fractionation here
6273 !could be the cause - JN.
6274 !************************************************
62751762905052887150 if(trace_water .and. present(wtr)) then
6276211548600405468150 wtr0(k,:,:) = wtr(k,:,:) !save original values
62777051620088145250 do m=1,wtrc_nwset !Loop over water species
6278 !Calculate condensate ratios:
6279 !NOTE: Since condensation comes from vapor, vapor is the source, and thus R must be calculated from vapor. - JN
62807051620070516200 Rv = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),wtr0(k,m,1),wtr0(k,1,1))
6281 !Modify tendencies:
6282 wtten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) = wtten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtliq)) + Rv*dql/dt
6283 wtten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)) = wtten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtice)) + Rv*dqi/dt
6284 wtten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = wtten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) - Rv*(dql+dqi)/dt
6285 !Modifty states:
6286 wtr(k,m,2) = wtr(k,m,2) + Rv*dql
6287 wtr(k,m,3) = wtr(k,m,3) + Rv*dqi
6288 wtr(k,m,1) = wtr(k,m,1) - Rv*(dql+dqi)
6289 end do
6290211548600405468150 wtr0(k,:,:) = wtr(k,:,:) !save original values (again)
62917051620088145250 do m=1,wtrc_nwset !loop over water species
6292 !Calculate water vapor ratio:
629370516200141032400 Rv = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),wtr0(k,m,1),wtr0(k,1,1))
6294 !Modify vapor tendency:
6295 wtten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = wtten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) + Rv*dqv/dt
6296 !Modify vapor state:
6297 wtr(k,m,1) = wtr(k,m,1) + Rv*dqv
6298 if( k .ne. 1 ) then !Make sure you aren't at bottom level, then take from level below:
62996816566068165660 wtr(k-1,m,1) = wtr(k-1,m,1) - Rv*(dqv*dp(k)/dp(k-1))
6300 wtten(k-1,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = wtten(k-1,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))- Rv*(dqv*dp(k)/dp(k-1)/dt)
6301 end if
63027051620070516200 Rv = wtrc_get_rstd(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap))) !use standard ratio when setting value to qmin. - JN
6303 wtr(k,m,1) = max(wtr(k,m,1),Rv*qvmin) !Make sure it matches minimum (use standard ratio?)
6304 wtr(k,m,2) = max(wtr(k,m,2),Rv*qlmin)
6305 wtr(k,m,3) = max(wtr(k,m,3),Rv*qimin)
6306 end do
6307 end if !water tracers
6308 !************************************************
6309 end do
6310 ! Extra moisture used to satisfy 'qv(i,1)=qvmin' is proportionally
6311 ! extracted from all the layers that has 'qv > 2*qvmin'. This fully
6312 ! preserves column moisture.
6313587635587635 if( dqv .gt. 1.e-20_r8 ) then
631400 sum = 0._r8
631500 do k = 1, mkx
631600 if( qv(k) .gt. 2._r8*qvmin ) sum = sum + qv(k)*dp(k)
6317 enddo
631800 aa = dqv*dp(1)/max(1.e-20_r8,sum)
6319 if( aa .lt. 0.5_r8 ) then
632000 do k = 1, mkx
632100 if( qv(k) .gt. 2._r8*qvmin ) then
632200 dum = aa*qv(k)
6323 qv(k) = qv(k) - dum
6324 qvten(k) = qvten(k) - dum/dt
6325 !**************
6326 !Water tracers:
6327 !**************
6328 if(trace_water) then
632900 wtr0(k,:,:) = wtr(k,:,:) !save original values
633000 do m=1, wtrc_nwset !Loop over water species
6331 !Calculate water vapor ratio:
633200 Rv = wtrc_ratio(iwspec(wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)),wtr0(k,m,1),wtr0(k,1,1))
6333 !Modify tracer state:
6334 wtr(k,m,1) = wtr(k,m,1) - Rv*dum
6335 !Modify tracer tendency:
6336 wtten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) = wtten(k,wtrc_iatype(m,iwtvap)) - Rv*dum/dt
6337 end do
6338 end if
6339 !**************
6340 endif
6341 enddo
6342 else
634300 write(iulog,*) 'Full positive_moisture is impossible in uwshcu'
6344 endif
6345 endif
6346
6347 return
6348 end subroutine positive_moisture_single
6349

6352 ! End of subroutine blocks !
6353 ! !
6354 ! ------------------------ !
